LOC_EVENT_TOPIC_TECHNOLOGY_HELP.source: 将表达关联到科学发现、新技术、人工智能与网络工具。
LOC_EVENT_TOPIC_TECHNOLOGY_HELP.zh_CN: 把表达接到科学发现、新技术、人工智能和网络工具这些事上。
LOC_EVENT_TOPIC_TECHNOLOGY_HELP.en: Tie the expression to scientific finds, new technology, artificial intelligence and online tools.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_POSIT.source: 选票让长期执政者交出了席位
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_POSIT.zh_CN: 连坐三届的位置总算换人了，选票还是管点用的
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_POSIT.en: Three straight terms in the same seats and they're finally out; turns out ballots still do something

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_NEGAT.source: 新的联盟仍要争夺财政分配权
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_NEGAT.zh_CN: 旧人刚下去，新上桌的这几家还得先为怎么分钱吵一架
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_NEGAT.en: The old crowd barely cleared out and the new ones at the table already have to fight over splitting the money

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_TITLE.source: 执政联盟在议会选举中失去多数
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_TITLE.zh_CN: 海岸联盟在议会选举中失去多数席位

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_NARRA.source: %s公布议会选举结果：海岸联盟失去连续掌握三届的多数席位，改革党以降低住房税为条件开启组阁谈判。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_NARRA.zh_CN: %s公布议会选举结果：海岸联盟丢掉了连续掌握三届的多数席位，改革党随即开出降低住房税的条件，加入组阁谈判。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_NARRA.en: %s releases its parliamentary election results: the Coast Coalition loses the majority it held for three straight terms, and the Reform Party enters coalition talks demanding lower housing taxes.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_COMME.source: 组阁之前，每一票都像可以兑换的筹码。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_COMME.zh_CN: 平时不起眼的那几张散票，也就组阁这几天最值钱了。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_ASSEMBLY_COMME.en: Those stray backbench votes nobody looks twice at are never worth more than during coalition week.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_POSITIV.source: 公开账目让挪用经费有了可追索的证据
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_POSITIV.zh_CN: 采购明细一摊开，哪笔钱被人动过手脚总算有迹可循了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_POSITIV.en: Put the procurement ledger out in the open and you can finally see whose hands were in the till

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_NEGATIV.source: 账目公开后才知道被公开的钱去了哪里
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_NEGATIV.zh_CN: 要不是今天把旧明细放出来，谁知道三所学校能买回同一台机器
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_NEGATIV.en: If they hadn't opened the old ledger today, who would've guessed three schools bought the exact same machine

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_TITLE.source: 财政部公开逐笔采购账目
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_TITLE.zh_CN: 财政部开放五年采购明细
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_TITLE.en: Treasury releases five years of procurement records

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_NARRATI.source: %s财政部开放过去五年的采购明细，民间会计发现三所学校向同一家空壳公司采购了相同编号的实验设备。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_NARRATI.zh_CN: %s财政部开放了过去五年的采购明细。几名民间会计逐条比对后发现，竟有三所学校向同一家空壳公司买下了机身编号完全相同的实验设备。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_NARRATI.en: %s's finance ministry opens five years of procurement records. Comparing entries line by line, volunteer accountants find three schools bought lab equipment bearing the exact same serial number from a single shell company.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_COMMENT.source: 数字本身很安静，重复的设备编号就不一样了。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_COMMENT.zh_CN: 做假账连编号都不改一下，对查账的人是不是太缺乏尊重了？
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BUDGET_OPEN_DATA_COMMENT.en: Cooking the books without even changing the serial number feels a little disrespectful to the auditors, doesn't it?

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_POSITIVE.source: 地方居民终于能决定自己的议会
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 总算不用再捆在一块儿凑合过日子了，往后各选各的议会
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_POSITIVE.en: No more forcing everyone under one roof; from here on out each region elects its own parliament

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NEGATIVE.source: 边界画完了，养老金还没画完
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 分家协议签得倒是痛快，交了半辈子的跨区养老金到底找谁领
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NEGATIVE.en: Signing the split went smoothly enough, now tell us who's paying the cross-region pension I paid into for half my life

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NARRATIV.source: %s的三个自治地区签署《白港协议》，约定一年内分别建立议会。共同货币暂留十八个月，跨区养老金的归属仍未谈妥。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NARRATIV.zh_CN: %s的三个自治地区签署《白港协议》，约定一年内各自建立议会。共同货币暂时保留十八个月，至于跨区养老金由谁接手，眼下还没谈拢。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_NARRATIV.en: Three autonomous regions in %s sign the Whiteharbor Agreement, pledging to set up separate parliaments within a year. Their shared currency stays in place for eighteen months, while nobody has agreed yet on who takes over cross-region pensions.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_COMMENT.source: 人们会先用新国旗讨论旧账单。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 旗子先换好了，养老金归谁发还没人认领。好办的事果然总排在最前面。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ARCHIVE_RELEASE_COMMENT.en: New flags are already picked out, while nobody wants to claim the pension bill. Easy jobs always make it to the front of the queue.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_POSITIV.source: 恢复秩序让公共空间可以重新开放
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_POSITIV.zh_CN: 先把街面上的乱子摁住，大伙儿出门才能踏实点
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_POSITIV.en: Keep a lid on the street trouble first so ordinary people can step outside without looking over their shoulders

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_NEGATIV.source: 十一个人合影也算局势复杂
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_NEGATIV.zh_CN: 十一个人站一块儿拍张毕业照也得提前打报告，干脆按排号笑算了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_NEGATIV.en: Eleven classmates standing on a lawn for a graduation photo need prior clearance now; might as well take numbers before we smile

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_TITLE.source: 临时内阁宣布紧急集会令
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_TITLE.zh_CN: 临时内阁要求超过十人的户外集会提前报备
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_TITLE.en: Interim cabinet requires advance approval for outdoor gatherings over ten

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_NARRATI.source: %s临时内阁以港口骚乱为由，要求超过十人的户外集会提前报备。大学社团发现毕业合影也被列入审批范围。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_NARRATI.zh_CN: %s临时内阁以港口骚乱为由，要求超过十人的户外集会一律提前报备。不少大学社团随后发现，连草坪上的毕业合影也被划进了报备范围。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_NARRATI.en: Citing unrest at the port, %s's interim cabinet orders advance registration for all outdoor gatherings of more than ten people. University clubs soon discover that graduation photos on campus lawns fall under the rule too.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_COMMENT.source: 限制越具体，反话越容易找到落脚点。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 说是防着港口那边再闹起来，其实就是一刀切。为什么十一个人站在一块儿就算集会呢？
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NIGHT_QUIET_RULE_COMMENT.en: They say it's to keep the port quiet, then apply one blanket rule everywhere. Since when do eleven people standing together count as a rally?

LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_POSITIVE.source: 远郊居民终于不用为距离支付额外代价
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 住远郊的人总算松口气，每天上下班不用再按站数挨刀了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_POSITIVE.en: Outer-suburb commuters can finally breathe easy instead of getting bled by the stop every morning and evening

LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NEGATIVE.source: 统一票价把两站路也统一成了远途
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 我就坐两站路去买个菜，凭什么跟跨城通勤的人掏一样的车钱
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NEGATIVE.en: I'm riding two stops to buy groceries, why am I paying the same fare as someone crossing the whole city

LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_TITLE.source: 新公共交通票价法案通过
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_TITLE.zh_CN: 议会通过公共交通固定票价方案
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_TITLE.en: Parliament replaces distance-based transit fares with flat rate

LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NARRATIVE.source: %s议会取消按里程计费，改为每程固定收费。远郊通勤者省下月票钱，短途乘客的单程支出却增加近一半。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s议会取消了公共交通按里程计费，统一改为上车一口价。住远郊的通勤族省下不少月票钱，只坐两三站的短途乘客每趟却要多掏近一半车费。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_NARRATIVE.en: %s's parliament scraps distance-based transit fares in favor of a single flat fare on boarding. Outer-suburb commuters save plenty on monthly passes, while short-hop riders going two or three stops pay nearly half again as much per trip.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_COMMENT.source: 同一张票，远处的人和近处的人算出的账不同。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 不用听两边讲什么道理，问一句每天坐几站车就知道了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSIT_FARE_COMMENT.en: No need to listen to either side's grand principles. Just ask how many stops they ride every day.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_POSITIVE.source: 边防部队称行动能阻止下一轮越境袭击
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 边防那边放话了，这回出手就是为了把下一轮越境袭击堵在门外
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_POSITIVE.en: Border command put the word out: stepping in now is meant to shut the door on the next cross-border raid

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_NEGATIVE.source: 火车运走了货，也运走了回家的日期
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 口岸一关、火车一征，今年还能不能回得去家又没准信了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_NEGATIVE.en: Crossings shut, trains commandeered, and whether we make it home at all this year is up in the air again

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_TITLE.source: 河谷停火协议在黎明破裂
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_TITLE.zh_CN: 边境河谷停火协议在第九天破裂
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_TITLE.en: Border-valley ceasefire breaks on ninth day

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_NARRATIVE.source: %s边境河谷的停火协议在生效第九天破裂，双方关闭两处口岸并征用货运列车。当地救援站开始登记失散家庭。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s边境河谷的停火协议在生效第九天破裂，双方随即关闭两处口岸并征用货运列车，沿线救援站已开始登记失散家庭。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_NARRATIVE.en: A ceasefire in %s's border valley collapses on its ninth day. Both sides shut two crossings and commandeer freight trains as relief posts along the line begin registering separated families.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_COMMENT.source: 战争新闻里的地名，会变成普通人的去向。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_COMMENT.zh_CN: 才维持了九天……这种时候，传得最快的总是找人的消息。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BORDER_WAR_COMMENT.en: Nine days was all it lasted… At times like this, the posts that travel fastest are always people looking for family.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_POSITIVE.source: 重力反转让老战术失灵，新玩家有了机会
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 重力一翻过来老套路全白搭，新手这回也能上去乱拳打死老师傅了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_POSITIVE.en: Flip gravity upside down and all the old playbooks go out the window; rookies get to brawl with veterans on even footing

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_NEGATIVE.source: 买了对战游戏，先练两小时排队
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 比赛通稿吹得震天响，买完游戏的我还在登录界面排第二个钟头呢
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_NEGATIVE.en: Tournament press releases are everywhere while I'm still staring at hour two of the login queue for a game I paid for

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_TITLE.source: 竞技游戏《玻璃海》正式发售
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_TITLE.zh_CN: 灯塔工作室发布重力对战游戏《玻璃海》
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_TITLE.en: Lighthouse Studio releases reversible-gravity game Glass Sea

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_NARRATIVE.source: %s的灯塔工作室发布竞技游戏《玻璃海》，主打可改变重力的三人对战。首日服务器排队超过两小时，赛事方已宣布秋季邀请赛。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s灯塔工作室发售三人竞技游戏《玻璃海》，主打随时翻转重力的场地对抗。开服当天登录排队超过两小时，赛事方却已提前官宣了秋季邀请赛。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_NARRATIVE.en: Lighthouse Studio in %s launches Glass Sea, a three-player arena game built around flipping gravity mid-match. Login queues pass two hours on day one, even as organizers go ahead and announce an autumn invitational.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_COMMENT.source: 排队的截图常常比第一场比赛先传出去。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_COMMENT.zh_CN: 比赛日程都定好了，就是不知道选手现在排进服务器没有。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROOFTOP_MATCH_COMMENT.en: The tournament schedule is all locked in. Wonder if the players have made it past the login queue yet.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_POSITIV.source: 五代租客让一间房容下了不同的人生
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_POSITIV.zh_CN: 连布景都没换就演活了五代租客，一个人硬是把整座空屋子撑满了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_POSITIV.en: Five generations of tenants brought to life without a single set change; one actor filled that whole bare room

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_NEGATIV.source: 十七分钟谢幕，也比等房东修水管快
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_NEGATIV.zh_CN: 十七分钟谢幕，也比等房东修水管快
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_NEGATIV.en: Seventeen minutes of applause is still faster than a landlord fixing a pipe

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_TITLE.source: 索娜《空房间》巡演抵达新一站
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_TITLE.zh_CN: 索娜独角戏《空房间》谢幕十七分钟，下一站门票当晚售罄
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_TITLE.en: Sona's solo play Empty Rooms draws 17-minute curtain call; next stop sells out overnight

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_NARRATI.source: %s演员索娜带着独角戏《空房间》完成新一站演出。她不换布景便扮演五代租客，本场谢幕持续十七分钟，下一站门票也开始加售。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_NARRATI.zh_CN: %s演员索娜带着独角戏《空房间》演完新一站，全程不换布景一人分饰五代租客。当晚谢幕掌声持续了十七分钟，下一站加推的门票也在散场后抢购一空。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_NARRATI.en: Actor Sona wraps another tour stop of her solo play Empty Rooms in %s, playing five generations of tenants without changing the set once. Applause at curtain call runs for seventeen minutes, and extra tickets for the next city sell out the same night.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_COMMENT.source: 观众会把舞台上的房间带回自己的日常。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_COMMENT.zh_CN: 连续鼓掌十七分钟，站在台上等大家停下来的人应该也挺不知所措的。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COURTYARD_MARKET_COMMENT.en: Seventeen straight minutes of applause. Standing onstage waiting for everyone to stop must get a little awkward too.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_POSIT.source: 不可靠叙述给读者留下了共同推理的空间
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_POSIT.zh_CN: 一封寄错门的遗嘱把所有人都绕进去了，光是猜那个“我”到底是谁就够盘半宿
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_POSIT.en: One misdelivered will has everyone tangled up; just arguing over who the 'I' in the book is can fill half the night

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_NEGAT.source: 叙述者可能不存在，预售尾款肯定存在
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_NEGAT.zh_CN: 书里的叙述者存不存在另说，反正我预售的尾款是实打实扣掉了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_NEGAT.en: Whether the narrator in the book is real or not, the final payment from my bank card sure was

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_TITLE.source: 小说《第七码头》提前售罄
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_TITLE.zh_CN: 艾缇新小说《第七码头》发行前售罄
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_TITLE.en: Aeti's new novel The Seventh Pier sells out before release

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_NARRA.source: %s作家艾缇的新小说《第七码头》在发行前售罄，故事从一封寄错地址的遗嘱展开。书店安排通宵签售，读者争论叙述者是否存在。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_NARRA.zh_CN: %s作家艾缇的新小说《第七码头》尚未正式上架便宣告售罄。全书由一封寄错地址的遗嘱切入，多家书店临时加排通宵签售，拿到样书的读者已经在争论书里的叙述者是否确有其人。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_NARRA.en: Author Aeti's new novel The Seventh Pier sells out ahead of release in %s. Opening with a will delivered to the wrong door, the book prompts shops to add overnight signings while early readers argue over whether its narrator even exists.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_COMME.source: 一本书的争论，会写出书外的另一段故事。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_COMME.zh_CN: 书还没正式上架就已经吵起来了，连宣传费都省了一笔。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LIBRARY_LATE_HOURS_COMME.en: Readers are already fighting over it before it hits the shelves. Saves the publisher a marketing budget.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_POSITI.source: 小制作也能让观众围绕一句台词共同创作
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_POSITI.zh_CN: 没什么大场面的小成本片子，偏偏靠一句冷飕飕的台词让人记了好几个礼拜
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_POSITI.en: Zero big-budget spectacle, yet one chilly line of dialogue has stuck in people's heads for weeks

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NEGATI.source: 看完电影后，所有告别都开始需要查票
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NEGATI.zh_CN: 后劲太大了，散场去坐地铁听见广播报站都下意识想摸一下车票
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NEGATI.en: That movie lingered way too hard; walked down to the subway afterward and reached for my ticket the second the station chime played

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_TITLE.source: 电影《纸月车站》刷新本土票房纪录
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_TITLE.zh_CN: 低成本电影《纸月车站》连续三周领跑票房
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_TITLE.en: Low-budget film Paper Moon Station leads box office for three weeks

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NARRAT.source: %s上映的低成本电影《纸月车站》连续三周登顶票房。片中售票员每次说完同一句告别语，就有一位乘客从照片中消失。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NARRAT.zh_CN: %s上映的低成本电影《纸月车站》已连续三周稳居票房榜首。片中车站售票员每重复一次那句固定的送行话，旧合照上就会悄无声息地少掉一位乘客。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_NARRAT.en: Low-budget film Paper Moon Station holds the top spot at %s's box office for a third straight week. Every time the station clerk repeats the same parting line, one more passenger disappears without a sound from an old group photo.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_COMMEN.source: 重复的台词给不同场景留出了入口。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_COMMEN.zh_CN: 越是让人心里发毛的台词，散场后越有人喜欢拿来复读。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CAPTION_GUIDELINE_COMMEN.en: The creepier a line feels in the theater, the more people love repeating it once they're outside.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_POSITI.source: 旧船坞成了普通人能走进去的公共记忆
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_POSITI.zh_CN: 废弃的老船坞亮起灯来还真挺像样，顺手给以后的自己留句话也算个念想
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_POSITI.en: The old abandoned dock looks sharp all lit up, and leaving a note for your future self makes a nice keepsake

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NEGATI.source: 未来的自己先收到今天的门票账单
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NEGATI.zh_CN: 园区磨磨蹭蹭修了七年，轮到我写明信片倒只给一个钟头倒计时
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NEGATI.en: They dragged their feet for seven years building the park, then put a one-hour timer on me writing a postcard

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_TITLE.source: 云鲸主题公园开放夜间园区
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_TITLE.zh_CN: 云鲸主题公园开放旧船坞夜间园区
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_TITLE.en: Cloud Whale theme park opens night district along old dock

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NARRAT.source: %s的云鲸主题公园完成七年建设，开放沿旧船坞铺设的夜间园区。最受关注的项目要求游客在一小时内寄出给未来自己的明信片。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NARRAT.zh_CN: %s云鲸主题公园历时七年施工，正式开放沿旧船坞改建的夜间园区。园内排起长队的热门项目，是限时一小时写完并投递给未来自己的明信片。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_NARRAT.en: After seven years of construction, Cloud Whale Theme Park in %s opens its nighttime district along a converted old dock. Its longest queue forms outside a booth giving visitors one hour to write and mail a postcard to their future selves.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_COMMEN.source: 景点越有仪式感，游客越会带走一套动作。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_COMMEN.zh_CN: 自己施工用了七年，倒只给游客留一个小时写信。时间观念还挺灵活的。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_TERM_BREAK_NOTICE_COMMEN.en: Seven years to finish construction, one hour for visitors to finish a letter. Flexible sense of time.

LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_POSITIVE.source: 业余球队让冠军与普通劳动者连在一起
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 平时跑单练出来的体格真不含糊，赢下职业队还记得把借来的学校球场修好
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_POSITIVE.en: Years of hauling parcels built some real stamina; they beat a pro club and still remembered to fix the school pitch they borrow

LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NEGATIVE.source: 职业球队输给了一群还要赶晚班的人
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 天天全职训练的职业队，补时让人家下了晚班来踢球的给绝杀了
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NEGATIVE.en: Full-time pros training every day just got sunk in stoppage time by guys who came straight off the evening delivery shift

LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_TITLE.source: 屋顶联赛决赛由业余球队夺冠
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_TITLE.zh_CN: 快递员组成的灰鸥队补时反超夺得屋顶联赛冠军
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_TITLE.en: Delivery riders' Grey Gulls win Rooftop League final in added time

LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NARRATIVE.source: %s屋顶联赛的决赛中，由快递员组成的灰鸥队在补时反超职业球队。夺冠奖金将用来修复他们长期借用的学校球场。
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s屋顶联赛决赛爆出冷门，由快递员凑起来的灰鸥队在伤停补时阶段反超职业俱乐部夺冠，赛后宣布把奖金拿去翻修他们常年借用的学校球场。
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_NARRATIVE.en: %s's Rooftop League final ends in an upset as the Grey Gulls, a squad put together by delivery riders, come back in stoppage time to beat a professional club and pledge the prize money to resurface the school pitch they borrow.

LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_COMMENT.source: 人们会记住最后一球，也会记住谁明天还要上班。
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_COMMENT.zh_CN: 今晚刚赢了职业队，明天早上还是得准点去取件。
LOC_EVENT_CITY_TOURNAMENT_COMMENT.en: Beat a pro club tonight, still have to clock in for morning pickups tomorrow.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_POSITIVE.source: 救援队和民间车队正在共同疏散居民
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 山路不好走，好在救援队和自发赶来的私家车一直没停，正一趟趟往外接人
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_POSITIVE.en: Rough as those mountain roads are, rescue crews and volunteer drivers haven't let up, ferrying people out trip after trip

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NEGATIVE.source: 百年一遇的洪水又赶上了今年
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 雨一下五天铁路又断了，预警模型怎么回回都在这种时候算少水量
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NEGATIVE.en: Five days of rain and the rail line is cut again; funny how the flood model only ever undercounts the water when it pours

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_TITLE.source: 持续暴雨中断北岭铁路运输
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_TITLE.zh_CN: 北岭流域连日降雨致铁路再度停运
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_TITLE.en: Five days of rain halt North Ridge rail service again

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NARRATIVE.source: %s北岭流域连续五天降雨，落石与涨水使铁路再度停运。气象局称预警模型仍低估上游汇水，救援车辆沿山路转运受困居民。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s北岭流域连下五天暴雨，落石和涨水再次逼停铁路。气象局承认预警模型低估了上游汇水量，目前救援车队正沿山路分批转运受困居民。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_NARRATIVE.en: Five straight days of cloudbursts across %s's North Ridge basin send rockfalls and floodwater onto the tracks, halting rail service again. The weather bureau admits its warning model underestimated upstream runoff as rescue convoys shuttle stranded residents out along mountain roads.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_COMMENT.source: 灾情里传播得快的，往往是求助地点和一句问责。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_COMMENT.zh_CN: 模型算错了还能发声明修正，困在半路上的人就只能等车了。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BRIDGE_DETOUR_COMMENT.en: When a model gets the numbers wrong, the bureau can issue a correction. People stuck halfway up the road just have to wait for a ride.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_POSITIVE.source: 停工令承认高温下劳动者需要保护
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 四十多度的天总算发了午后停工令，大太阳底下干活的人好歹能名正言顺歇口气
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_POSITIVE.en: Past forty degrees and there's finally an afternoon work halt, so folks out under the blazing sun get a proper breather

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NEGATIVE.source: 太阳已经下班，计时器还在加班
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 外头地面都快烤化了，停工令管得住工地，怎么就管不住软件里那个倒计时
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NEGATIVE.en: The asphalt outside is practically melting; if the halt order stops building sites, how come it can't touch the countdown in the app

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_TITLE.source: 热浪触发新一轮户外停工令
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_TITLE.zh_CN: 南部高温持续九天，骑手晒出超时罚单
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_TITLE.en: Riders post heatwave late penalties as officials announce afternoon outdoor work ban

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NARRATIVE.source: %s南部连续九天气温超过四十度，劳动部门宣布新一轮午后露天停工令。送货平台仍按原时限考核，骑手开始公开晒出这轮高温中的超时罚单。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s南部连续九天气温突破四十度，劳动部门下达新一轮午后露天停工令。不过几家配送平台的送达时限分秒未改，不少骑手干脆把这几天的超时扣款单集中晒到了网上。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_NARRATIVE.en: With temperatures in southern %s topping forty degrees for nine straight days, labor officials order a fresh afternoon halt to outdoor work. Delivery apps leave their timers untouched to the second, prompting riders to post batches of heatwave late-penalty slips online.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_COMMENT.source: 天气会变成劳动议题，因为有人无法躲进室内。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_COMMENT.zh_CN: 停工令是发给人看的，可惜扣钱的是算法。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SHIFT_ROSTER_COMMENT.en: Work-halt notices are written for human beings. Shame an algorithm handles the fines.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_POSITIVE.source: 公共空间短暂让位给所有人都能看的天空
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 河边那排刺眼的广告屏总算肯黑两小时，借台学校的望远镜就能去等彗星了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_POSITIVE.en: Those glaring riverside ad screens are finally going dark for two hours; grab a loaner telescope from a school and wait for the comet

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NEGATIVE.source: 彗星路过两小时，广告屏终于休息两小时
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 平时投诉光污染没人理，合着得请一颗彗星路过才能让广告牌歇会儿
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NEGATIVE.en: Complain about light pollution all year and nobody blinks; turns out it takes a passing comet to get the billboards switched off

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_TITLE.source: 蓝尾彗星将在周末掠过近地轨道
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_TITLE.zh_CN: 穹顶天文台公布周末凌晨蓝尾彗星观测窗口
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_TITLE.en: Dome Observatory announces weekend pre-dawn viewing window for blue-tail comet

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NARRATIVE.source: %s穹顶天文台公布蓝尾彗星的观测窗口，周末凌晨可用肉眼看见。市政部门同意熄灭河岸广告屏两小时，学校借出望远镜。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s穹顶天文台预报，本周末凌晨肉眼就能看见掠过近地的蓝尾彗星。市政部门已答应届时关掉河岸广告大屏两小时，多所学校也向市民借出了望远镜。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_NARRATIVE.en: Dome Observatory in %s forecasts that a blue-tail comet skimming past Earth will be visible to the naked eye before dawn this weekend. City hall has agreed to switch off riverside ad screens for two hours while local schools lend out telescopes.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_COMMENT.source: 罕见的同一片天空，很容易成为共同记忆。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_COMMENT.zh_CN: 难得河边的广告屏肯关两个小时。只可惜是在凌晨，我是肯定起不来的。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BLUE_COMET_COMMENT.en: Rare to see those riverside ad screens go dark for two hours. Too bad it's before dawn; I'm definitely not waking up for it.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_POSITIVE.source: 开放果园让受损收成仍能被邻里分享
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 与其烂在地里不如让街坊捡回去吃，受了灾的果农这事办得真敞亮
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_POSITIVE.en: Better in neighbors' baskets than rotting on the ground; hats off to the growers for throwing the gates open after a hit like that

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NEGATIVE.source: 果农还没赚到，水果已经先涨价了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 地里的果农还没顾上擦眼泪呢，城里批发市场的价签倒是连夜往上翻了一截
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NEGATIVE.en: Growers out in the orchards haven't even wiped their eyes yet and city wholesalers already jacked up their price tags overnight

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_TITLE.source: 异常早霜使果园提前停收
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_TITLE.zh_CN: 东部果园提前三周遭初霜，青梨损失过半
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_TITLE.en: Early frost hits eastern orchards three weeks ahead of schedule

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NARRATIVE.source: %s东部果园提前三周遭遇初霜，青梨收成损失过半。果农开放受损果园让居民自取落果，批发市场却同时上调鲜果报价。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s东部果园比往年提早三周撞上初霜，树上的青梨冻损过半。当地果农敞开果园请附近居民免费捡走落果，城里的批发市场则在当天调高了鲜果报价。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_NARRATIVE.en: First frost hits eastern %s's orchards three weeks ahead of schedule, freezing more than half the green pears on the branch. Local growers open their gates so neighbors can gather fallen fruit for free, while city wholesale markets hike fresh-fruit quotes the same day.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_COMMENT.source: 人们讨论季节，也会讨论谁替坏天气买单。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_COMMENT.zh_CN: 地里的梨还没捡完，城里的批发价已经先涨上去了。消息传得比冷空气还快。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_FIRST_FROST_COMMENT.en: The fallen pears haven't even been picked up yet and wholesale prices in town are already up. Price tags travel faster than cold fronts.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_POSITIVE.source: 限水能让家庭保住基本生活用水
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 水库都快见底了，先按时段供水省着点用，起码能保住家家户户做饭洗漱
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_POSITIVE.en: With the reservoir nearly dry, scheduled water hours at least keep enough running for everyone to cook and wash up

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NEGATIVE.source: 旧城露出了钟，酒店还没到停水时间
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 水底老钟楼都晒着太阳了，凭什么居民拎桶接水，湖边酒店的泳池还能哗哗补水
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NEGATIVE.en: An old sunken bell tower is out sunbathing in the dry bed, so why are households hauling buckets while lakeside hotels top up their pools

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_TITLE.source: 七十年来最低水位暴露沉没旧城
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_TITLE.zh_CN: 西部水库降至七十年最低水位，水下旧城钟楼露出
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_TITLE.en: Western reservoir hits seventy-year low, exposing submerged bell tower

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NARRATIVE.source: %s西部水库降至七十年来最低水位，水下旧城的钟楼重新露出。供水公司开始分时供水，居民要求停止湖岸酒店泳池补水。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s西部水库跌至七十年来最低水位，淹没多年的旧城钟楼重新露出水面。自来水公司启动分时限水后，大批居民要求立刻叫停湖岸度假酒店的泳池补水。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_NARRATIVE.en: A western reservoir in %s drops to a seventy-year low, bringing the bell tower of a long-flooded town back above water. Once the water utility starts timed rationing, residents demand an immediate stop to pool refills at lakeside resort hotels.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_COMMENT.source: 旱情会把水位和社会地位放在同一张照片里。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_COMMENT.zh_CN: 本来大家还在围观水底露出来的老钟楼，一看见旁边的泳池，话题马上就变了。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DRY_RESERVOIR_COMMENT.en: Everyone started out gawking at the old bell tower sticking out of the water. One look at the hotel pools next door changed the subject fast.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_POSITIVE.source: 公开检测让罕见天气有了可核查的解释
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 化验结果出来是高空沙尘染的色，总算不用自己吓自己了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_POSITIVE.en: Lab tests say it's high-altitude dust tinting the snow, so at least we can stop scaring ourselves

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NEGATIVE.source: 雪都换颜色了，通知还没换模板
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 漫天下的都是红雪，等学校都停课了才出来解释，气象台昨晚集体睡着了？
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NEGATIVE.en: The whole sky dumps dark-red snow and we only get an explanation after schools shut; did the weather office sleep through last night?

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_TITLE.source: 红色降雪引发学校停课
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_TITLE.zh_CN: 高地多座城镇降下暗红色雪，学校停课待检
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_TITLE.en: Dark-red snow closes schools across several highland towns

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NARRATIVE.source: %s高地多座城镇降下暗红色雪，学校停课等待检测。研究站确认颜色来自高空沙尘，居民仍在追问为何没有提前收到气象提示。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s高地多座城镇一夜降下暗红色积雪，当地学校紧急停课等待取样化验。高山研究站随后确认雪色源自高空卷入的沙尘，不过居民仍在追问气象部门事前为何毫无预警。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_NARRATIVE.en: Dark-red snow blankets several highland towns in %s overnight, prompting emergency school closures while samples go in for testing. An alpine station confirms the color came from high-altitude dust, though residents keep asking why weather forecasters gave zero warning.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_COMMENT.source: 罕见景象带来好奇，通知迟到带来别的含义。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_COMMENT.zh_CN: 什么叫世界并没有毁灭？
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_RED_SNOW_COMMENT.en: What do you mean the world isn't ending?

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_POSITIVE.source: 自动化能提高公共服务效率，也能降低创作门槛
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 文字配图和语音全免费开放，一个人鼓捣点小作品可比以前省事太多了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_POSITIVE.en: Free text, pictures and voice all in one place makes tinkering on a solo project way less trouble than before

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NEGATIVE.source: 机器替我写了申请，也替人决定我能否获批
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 设计公司拿它砍外包就算了，连递上去的申请材料都要交给机器先筛一遍？
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NEGATIVE.en: Design shops cutting freelancers with it is bad enough, and now public procurement wants a machine screening applications first?

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_TITLE.source: 生成式人工智能“织灯”向公众开放
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_TITLE.zh_CN: 镜海实验室免费公开生成式人工智能“织灯”
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_TITLE.en: Mirrorsea Labs releases free generative AI Weavelight

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NARRATIVE.source: %s的镜海实验室公开生成式人工智能“织灯”，免费提供文字、图像和语音生成。设计公司宣布缩减外包，政府采购部门则试用自动审件。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s镜海实验室向公众免费开放生成式人工智能“织灯”，支持文字、图像与语音一键生成。消息公布后，多家设计公司宣布缩减外包预算，当地采购部门也开始拿它测试自动初审。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_NARRATIVE.en: Mirrorsea Labs in %s opens its generative AI system Weavelight to the public for free, producing text, images and voice on demand. Several design agencies promptly trim freelance budgets while local procurement offices begin testing it for first-pass screening.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_COMMENT.source: 同一项技术，会被当作能力、饭碗或审查员。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_COMMENT.zh_CN: 它应该还学不会我们这行吧……至少短期内？
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GENERATIVE_AI_COMMENT.en: It shouldn't be able to learn our line of work yet… at least in the short term?

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_POSITIVE.source: 长期投入和公开复核解决了跨越几代人的问题
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 整整九十六页，三个独立小组一行行挑刺都没挑出毛病，这回是真的证出来了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_POSITIVE.en: Ninety-six pages combed through line by line by three separate teams without a flaw; they really nailed it down this time

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NEGATIVE.source: 人类证出了猜想，我还拆不明白这个月的账单
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 人家把几百年的数学猜想都拆明白了，我连这个月的水电费还没算利索
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NEGATIVE.en: Someone just cracked a centuries-old math conjecture and I still haven't gotten this month's utility bill straight

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_TITLE.source: 罗比拉齐猜想的完整证明通过复核
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_TITLE.zh_CN: 数学家维索公布罗比拉齐猜想证明并通过三组复核
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_TITLE.en: Mathematician Viso's proof of Robilazzi conjecture passes three independent reviews

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NARRATIV.source: %s数学家伊莱娜·维索公布罗比拉齐猜想的九十六页证明：所有充分大的偶数都能拆成两个素数之和。三个独立小组完成逐行复核。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NARRATIV.zh_CN: %s数学家伊莱娜·维索发表了长达九十六页的罗比拉齐猜想证明，证实所有充分大的偶数都能拆成两个素数之和。目前三个独立审稿组已完成逐行复核。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_NARRATIV.en: Mathematician Ilena Viso in %s publishes a ninety-six-page proof of the Robilazzi conjecture, showing every sufficiently large even integer splits into the sum of two primes. Three independent review panels have now verified the proof line by line.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_COMMENT.source: 能看懂证明的人不多，能借题发挥的人会多得多。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_COMMENT.zh_CN: 我连第一页的符号都认不全，不过评论区好像突然多了很多数学家。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ROBILAZZI_PROOF_COMMENT.en: I don't even recognize half the symbols on page one, though the comment section seems to have sprouted a lot of mathematicians overnight.

LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_POSITIVE.source: 低能耗离线计算让个人设备少依赖云端
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 离线识别还能把功耗压到十分之一，以后不用什么话都往云端传了
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_POSITIVE.en: Offline voice recognition at a tenth of the power draw means we won't have to ship every word we say up to the cloud

LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NEGATIVE.source: 设备薄了一半，工资要攒两月
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 机器缩到巴掌大，价钱倒是胀到了我两个月工资，省下来的那点电费够回本吗
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NEGATIVE.en: Shrunk the gadget to palm size and swelled the price to two months of my pay; how many power bills would that take to earn back

LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_TITLE.source: 折叠式光算终端“萤石”发布
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_TITLE.zh_CN: 铄光公司发布低能耗光算终端“萤石”
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_TITLE.en: Shineglass releases low-power optical terminal Fluorite

LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NARRATIVE.source: %s铄光公司发布掌心大小的光算终端“萤石”，宣称离线语音识别能耗降至旧款十分之一。首批售价相当于普通职员两个月工资。
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s铄光公司推出掌心大小的光算终端“萤石”，宣称离线语音识别的耗电量只有上一代的十分之一，不过首批定价顶得上当地普通职员两个月薪水。
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_NARRATIVE.en: Shineglass in %s unveils Fluorite, a palm-sized optical terminal claiming offline speech recognition at one-tenth the power draw of the previous generation, with first-batch pricing equal to two months' pay for an average local clerk.

LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_COMMENT.source: 发布会说的是性能，评论区算的是工资。
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_COMMENT.zh_CN: 省下来的电费，攒多少年才够买这台机器？
LOC_EVENT_PLATFORM_TOOL_COMMENT.en: How many years of saved electricity bills would it take just to pay for the machine?

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_POSITIV.source: 自动运输减少危险路段的驾驶时间
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_POSITIV.zh_CN: 夜里跑险路的苦差事交给自动货车，老司机总算能少提心吊胆几趟
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_POSITIV.en: Handing dangerous night stretches over to automated trucks spares veteran drivers a few white-knuckle runs

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NEGATIV.source: 车可以无人，失业名单还得有人填
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NEGATIV.zh_CN: 车是可以没人开了，替下来的司机往哪儿去、半夜趴窝谁去修，总得给句准话
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NEGATIV.en: Fine, the cab doesn't need a driver, now tell us straight where displaced drivers go and who fixes a rig stalled at 2 a.m.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_TITLE.source: 无人货运公路试点新增线路
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_TITLE.zh_CN: 无人货运试点新增三条公路，工会要求公布转岗名额
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_TITLE.en: Driverless freight pilot adds three roads as unions demand retraining slots

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NARRATI.source: %s交通部门为无人货运试点新增三条普通公路，这批订单仍由港口仓储商承接。工会要求随线路扩张公布转岗名额，并为夜间故障保留人工值守。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NARRATI.zh_CN: %s交通部门把三条普通公路新纳入无人货运试点，货运订单继续由港口仓储商承接。当地运输工会随即发声，要求同步公开司机的转岗名额，并在夜间故障抢修上保留人工值守。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_NARRATI.en: Transport officials in %s add three regular highways to a driverless freight pilot, with port warehouse operators keeping the contracts. Local transport unions demand public retraining quotas alongside the expansion and human crews on call for nighttime breakdowns.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_COMMENT.source: 技术落地之后，抽象效率会变成具体的班表。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_COMMENT.zh_CN: 平时嫌人工贵，等车半夜坏在半路上，还是得靠人去修。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_STAFF_RETRAINING_COMMENT.en: Human labor is always called too expensive right up until a truck breaks down on the highway at midnight.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_POSITIVE.source: 跨机构样本验证让陌生生命进入公共知识
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 样本分送两家外地实验室交叉核验，这株洞穴新物种总算不只是传闻了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_POSITIVE.en: Samples went out to two outside labs for cross-checking, so this cave species is more than a tall tale now

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NEGATIVE.source: 植物学会了不晒太阳，我还没学会不加班
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 一株草在黑洞洞的地方不晒太阳也能硬撑着活，怎么越听越像在说我自己
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NEGATIVE.en: A pale little plant scraping by in pitch darkness without a ray of sun sounds uncomfortably like my own week

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_TITLE.source: 洞穴深处发现透明蕨类新物种
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_TITLE.zh_CN: 远山大学在石灰岩洞穴发现透明蕨类“璃叶”
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_TITLE.en: Farhill University discovers transparent cave fern Glassleaf

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NARRATIVE.source: %s远山大学在石灰岩洞穴发现透明蕨类“璃叶”，它借助共生细菌利用微弱化学能。样本已送往两所外地实验室，洞穴暂时限制游客进入。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s远山大学考察队在石灰岩深洞里发现了通体透明的新蕨类“璃叶”，不靠阳光，单凭共生细菌转化的一点化学能就能存活。目前样本已分送两所外地实验室复核，洞口也暂时对游客封闭。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_NARRATIVE.en: A Farhill University team in %s discovers a translucent fern dubbed Glassleaf deep inside a limestone cave, surviving without sunlight on trace chemical energy converted by symbiotic bacteria. Samples have gone to two outside labs for verification while the cave entrance stays closed to visitors.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_COMMENT.source: 新物种给人们提供了一种新的自我比喻。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_COMMENT.zh_CN: 常年不见阳光也能活下来……听着怎么有点像长期坐办公室的人。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_GLASS_FERN_COMMENT.en: Getting by year-round without seeing the sun… Sounds a little like office life.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_POSITIVE.source: 公开能耗让可重复的进展有了明确尺度
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 实打实往电网送了十分钟电，连耗电底数都全摊出来，这步迈得够扎实
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_POSITIVE.en: Ten straight minutes of real power fed into the city grid with every watt of input laid on the table; that's solid progress

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NEGATIVE.source: 未来供电十分钟，今天的电费一分没少
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 试验站往未来送了十分钟电，我家这个月的电费单倒是一分钱没少
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NEGATIVE.en: The test station sent ten minutes of electricity into the future and shaved zero cents off my power bill this month

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_TITLE.source: 首座聚变试验站维持供电十分钟
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_TITLE.zh_CN: 白环试验站首次向电网供电十分钟并公开能耗数据
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_TITLE.en: White Ring station supplies grid for ten minutes and releases full energy data

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NARRATIVE.source: %s白环试验站首次向电网持续供电十分钟。科研署公开全部能耗数据，指出点火设备仍需外部供电，商业化计划尚未获批。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s白环聚变试验站首次实现向市政电网连续供电十分钟。科研署同步公开了整场实验的能耗底账，坦承点火装置眼下还得仰仗外部输电，离商业化并网尚有距离。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_NARRATIVE.en: The White Ring fusion station in %s feeds power into the municipal grid for ten continuous minutes for the first time. Research officials release the full energy ledger alongside the test, noting that ignition still relies on external power and commercial grid service remains some way off.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_COMMENT.source: 实验的十分钟，足够被讲成不同的未来。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_COMMENT.zh_CN: 同一份实话实说的报告，乐观的人看前半页，悲观的人看后半页。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_EXAM_CALENDAR_COMMENT.en: One honest report: optimists read the first half, pessimists read the second.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_POSI.source: 可查证的原图能纠正流传的错误信息
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_POSI.zh_CN: 把档案馆里的原图编号翻出来对一遍，至少不用对着假图瞎吵了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_POSI.en: Pulling the original catalog number out of the archives at least stops everyone from brawling over a doctored scan

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NEGA.source: 原图找到了，吵架的路还很长
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NEGA.zh_CN: 原图编号都扒出来了，两边还能为谁故意裁掉半截图例再战三百回合
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NEGA.en: Even with the archive call number on the table, those two forums can still go another three hundred rounds over a cropped legend

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_TITL.source: 两大论坛再因史料真伪爆发骂战
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_TITL.zh_CN: 石阶论坛与潮汐论坛因百年前地图截图再起争执
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_TITL.en: Stone Steps and Tide forums clash again over cropped century-old map

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NARR.source: %s石阶论坛与潮汐论坛围绕一张新公开的百年前地图再次争吵。原图馆藏编号查明后，双方仍争论对方为何只截取图例一半。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NARR.zh_CN: %s老对头石阶论坛与潮汐论坛又因一张新公开的百年前地图吵得不可开交。哪怕原图的馆藏编号已被人核实，两边网友仍在互骂对方发帖时故意裁掉了半边图例。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_NARR.en: Longtime rivals Stone Steps and Tide forums in %s are at each other's throats again over a newly released century-old map. Even after someone verifies the original archive catalog number, users on both sides keep accusing each other of cropping half the legend on purpose.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_COMM.source: 找到出处能解决证据问题，未必解决站队问题。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_COMM.zh_CN: 原图都查出来了还能接着吵，说明大家本来也不是为了求证才进帖子的。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_CHECK_COMM.en: The original map is right there and they're still going at it, which tells you nobody clicked into that thread looking for facts.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_POS.source: 清理批量操纵能减少虚假声量
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_POS.zh_CN: 把成批刷热度的水军号清一清，评论区总算能多看几句活人话
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_POS.en: Clearing out Astroturf accounts by the batch finally leaves room for a few real human sentences in the replies

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NEG.source: 机器人还在发言，新闻档案先闭嘴了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NEG.zh_CN: 刷屏的假号还没死绝，刚建起来存旧闻的归档号倒先给一锅端了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NEG.en: The spam bots aren't even gone yet and fresh news-archive accounts built to back up old stories got wiped out in the same net

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_TIT.source: 广场网新一轮清理封禁大量账号
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_TIT.zh_CN: 广场网封禁约二十万账号，独立媒体称归档号也遭冻结
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_TIT.en: SquareNet bans roughly 200,000 accounts; outlets say news archives were frozen too

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NAR.source: %s广场网在新一轮清理中以“协同操纵”为由封禁约二十万账号，仍未公开判定阈值。独立媒体称其新建的新闻归档账号也在本轮被冻结。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NAR.zh_CN: %s社交平台广场网以“协同操纵”为由一口气封禁约二十万个账号，具体判定门槛依旧秘而不宣。多家独立媒体随后投诉，称他们刚注册用来备份旧报道的归档号也在同一晚被冻结。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_NAR.en: Social platform SquareNet in %s bans roughly two hundred thousand accounts in one sweep for 'coordinated manipulation' while keeping its detection thresholds secret. Several independent outlets complain that new archive accounts they registered to back up past reporting were frozen the same night.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_COM.source: 封号会缩小渠道，也会让剩下的表达更绕。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_COM.zh_CN: 连判定标准都不公开，误伤了谁也只能算对方运气不好。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_PLATFORM_ORDER_TRIAL_COM.en: When the rules stay secret, anyone caught in the net just has to chalk it up to bad luck.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_POSI.source: 公开页面的镜像能保住社区共同记忆
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_POSI.zh_CN: 好在有非营利团队出面谈公共页面镜像，十几年的老帖子不至于全烂在硬盘里
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_POSI.en: Thank goodness a nonprofit stepped up to negotiate a public mirror so nineteen years of old threads don't rot on a dead drive

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_NEGA.source: 十九年的朋友，要在三十天里逐页打包
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_NEGA.zh_CN: 攒了十九年的熟人和旧话，只给三十天一页页手动往外搬，连个打包按钮都舍不得给
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_NEGA.en: Nineteen years of friends and old talk, thirty days to save them one page at a time, and they couldn't even spare a bulk-export button

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_TITL.source: 老牌社交平台“回声巷”宣布关闭
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_TITL.zh_CN: 运营十九年的“回声巷”宣布三十天后关站
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_TITL.en: Echo Lane announces closure after nineteen years in operation

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_NARR.source: %s运营十九年的“回声巷”宣布三十天后关站。用户只能逐页导出旧帖，非营利档案团体协商接收公共页面镜像。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_NARR.zh_CN: %s陪伴老网民十九年的社交站点“回声巷”突然贴出停运告示，只留三十天缓冲期。由于后台只支持逐页手动保存旧帖，一家非营利档案团队正加紧和站方商量接手公共页面的镜像。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_NARR.en: Echo Lane, a nineteen-year-old hangout for longtime netizens in %s, posts a sudden shutdown notice giving users thirty days. Because the backend only saves old posts one page at a time by hand, a nonprofit archive group is scrambling to negotiate a mirror of public pages.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_COMM.source: 平台关闭时，人们才看清关系寄存在哪些按钮里。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_COMM.zh_CN: 十九年的记录只能一页页手动存。原来所谓的永久保存，保质期也就十九年。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_NETWORK_MAINTENANCE_COMM.en: Nineteen years of posts, saved one page at a time by hand. Turns out 'permanent online storage' has a shelf life of nineteen years.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_POSIT.source: 普通劳动者可以自己决定如何被看见
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_POSIT.zh_CN: 不用别人替他配煽情解说，十六段自己拍的回家路比什么都清楚
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_POSIT.en: No tearjerker voice-over speaking on his behalf; sixteen quiet shots he filmed on the walk home say plenty on their own

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_NEGAT.source: 城市刚醒，他的一天已经用完了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_NEGAT.zh_CN: 整座城刚揉着眼睛醒过来，拍视频的人已经把一整天的力气耗光了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_NEGAT.en: The whole city is just rubbing its eyes awake and the guy holding the phone is already wrung dry for the day

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_TITLE.source: 《夜班之后》新一集引发传播热潮
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_TITLE.zh_CN: 夜班清洁工手机短片《夜班之后》获多平台推荐
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_TITLE.en: Night cleaner's phone-shot film After the Night Shift draws platform recommendations

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_NARRA.source: %s一位夜班清洁工用手机发布纪录短片系列《夜班之后》的新一集。影片没有旁白，只有十六段清晨回家路上的固定镜头，多家平台开始推荐本集。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_NARRA.zh_CN: %s一名夜班清洁工用手机上传了纪实短片《夜班之后》的新一集，全片没配一句旁白，只剪进了清晨下班路上十六个安静的固定机位，很快被多家视频平台推上首页。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_NARRA.en: A night-shift cleaner in %s uploads a new installment of his phone-shot documentary After the Night Shift: zero narration, just sixteen still, quiet camera angles along his walk home at daybreak, soon pushed onto the front page across video sites.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_COMME.source: 没有旁白的画面，也会让人写出很多句子。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_COMME.zh_CN: 作者自己一句话都没说，反倒是评论区替他写了好几万字。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_LANGUAGE_HELP_DESK_COMME.en: The creator didn't say a single word himself, so the comment section wrote tens of thousands on his behalf.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_POSITIVE.source: 共同协议让朋友不再被不同平台隔开
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 不用为不同圈子的熟人来回切三四个聊天软件，一个号能发通真是省心
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_POSITIVE.en: Not having to juggle three or four chat apps for different circles of friends makes one cross-network account a relief

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_NEGATIVE.source: 墙还没拆，门口先多了两份身份证明
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 嘴上说是怕第三方客户端验不准身份，说白了还是舍不得把自家院墙拆了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_NEGATIVE.en: They talk about third-party identity checks, when plain and simple they can't bear taking down the walls around their own yard

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_TITLE.source: 聊天软件“线桥”开放跨平台协议
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_TITLE.zh_CN: 聊天软件“线桥”开放互通，两家大型平台拒绝接入
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_TITLE.en: Chat app Threadbridge opens cross-service messaging as two major platforms refuse access

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_NARRATIVE.source: %s聊天软件“线桥”允许用户保留账号与其他服务互发消息。两家大型平台拒绝接入，理由是无法核验第三方客户端身份。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s聊天软件“线桥”开放跨平台互通，用户不必重开账号就能给外部软件的好友发消息。不过当地两家社交巨头当即回绝接入，理由是没法核验第三方客户端的真实身份。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_NARRATIVE.en: Chat app Threadbridge in %s opens cross-platform messaging so users can reach friends on outside services without registering a new account. Two local social giants refuse to connect right away, saying they cannot verify the identity of third-party clients.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_COMMENT.source: 能否互通，会决定一句话能走多远。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_COMMENT.zh_CN: 不想放用户走直说就是了，何必赖在身份核验头上。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_OPEN_PROTOCOL_COMMENT.en: If you don't want to let your users wander off, just say so instead of blaming identity checks.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_POSITIVE.source: 停用过时缓存能减少错误页面继续流传
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 清掉早就失效的老旧缓存，至少搜东西的时候少点进几个死链接
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_POSITIVE.en: Sweeping out dead cached pages from years ago at least spares us clicking into half as many broken links

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_NEGATIVE.source: 网页学会了遗忘，承诺也跟着升级了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 原网站偷偷删了帖，这边连历史快照也一块儿关了，当年拍胸脯的话直接死无对证
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_NEGATIVE.en: The original sites deleted their posts on the sly and now the web cache is gone too; every big promise from back then vanished without a trace

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_TITLE.source: 搜索服务撤下二十年的网页快照
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_TITLE.zh_CN: 搜索服务“寻径”停止历史网页快照
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_TITLE.en: Search service Pathfind removes cached web pages

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_NARRATIVE.source: %s搜索服务“寻径”停止历史网页快照，称维护成本超过广告收入。调查记者发现，数起公共承诺的原始页面在现网站已无法找到。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s搜索引擎“寻径”下线了攒下二十年的历史网页快照，官方说法是存储开销盖过了广告进账。几名调查记者随后发现，早年数起公共承诺的原帖在原网站上也早已不见踪影。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_NARRATIVE.en: Search engine Pathfind in %s takes twenty years of cached web snapshots offline, saying storage bills outgrew ad revenue. Investigative reporters soon note that the original pages for several past public pledges have already vanished from their source sites too.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_COMMENT.source: 找不到的原文，会让截图承担更重的争论。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_COMMENT.zh_CN: 偏偏挑在原帖找不见的时候把快照也关了。这笔存储费省得还挺巧的。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DELETED_SEARCH_COMMENT.en: Shutting the snapshot archive right when the original pages go missing. Convenient timing to save on storage.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.source: 预算和内阁终于要向选民负责
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.zh_CN: 预算和组阁权总算交到民选议会手里，花多少钱得先过选民这一关了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.en: Budgets and cabinet powers are finally in an elected parliament's hands; spending public money has to get past voters first now

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.source: 钥匙交出来了，庄园税还想再商量一年
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.zh_CN: 大印是交出来了，旧顾问院还得再留一年，刚聊到王室庄园交税就拉扯上了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.en: The royal seal was handed over, sure, yet the old advisory council stays another year and royal estate taxes already started a tug-of-war

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.source: 王室签署民选议会移权宪章
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.zh_CN: 王室签署《春潮宪章》移交预算与组阁权
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.en: Royal court signs Springtide Charter transferring budget and cabinet-formation powers

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.source: %s王室签署《春潮宪章》，将预算和组阁权移交民选议会。旧顾问院保留一年过渡任期，首场公开听证围绕王室地产税展开。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.zh_CN: %s王室正式签署《春潮宪章》，把财政预算与内阁组建权移交给民选议会。原王室顾问院仍保留一年过渡期，而新议会的首场公开听证就直接挑中了王室地产税议题。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.en: The royal house in %s signs the Springtide Charter, handing budget authority and cabinet formation to an elected parliament. The former royal advisory council keeps a one-year transition term as the new assembly's opening public hearing goes straight after taxes on royal estates.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.source: 权力移交时，留下的过渡条款也会成为话题。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.zh_CN: 字刚签完就开始算王室自己的地产税了，连几天的客套期都没留。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_CONSTITUTION_TRANSITION_.en: The ink is barely dry and they're already calculating taxes on royal land. Didn't even leave a few days for polite small talk.

LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_POSITIVE.source: 平静口吻让难以直说的不满有了出口
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 排期都炸成一锅粥了，借张着火图平静说句“一切正常”，同事一眼就能懂
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_POSITIVE.en: When the project schedule is a five-alarm fire, dropping a burning-room cartoon that calmly says 'This is fine' tells coworkers everything

LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_NEGATIVE.source: 房间都着火了，日报还显示一切正常
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 屋顶都快烧塌了，周报上还得工工整整写着一切正常
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_NEGATIVE.en: The roof is about to cave in and our weekly status report still has to say 'Everything on track' in neat little rows

LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_TITLE.source: “一切正常”的着火房间开始流行
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_TITLE.zh_CN: 配文“一切正常”的着火房间图在职场走红
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_TITLE.en: Burning-room image captioned 'This Is Fine' spreads among workers

LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_NARRATIVE.source: %s一则配着“一切正常”的着火房间画面流行起来，使用者把明显失控的工作安排写进平静的旁白。
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s一张端坐火场却配文“一切正常”的漫画在打工人之间迅速传开，大家纷纷把眼看就要崩盘的工作排期塞进那句平静的台词里。
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_NARRATIVE.en: A cartoon of someone sitting calmly in a burning room saying 'This is fine' spreads fast among office workers in %s, as people stuff visibly collapsing work schedules inside that deadpan line.

LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_COMMENT.source: 平静与失控之间的落差，就是它的识别点。
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_COMMENT.zh_CN: 老实说，这种假装一切正常的精神状态，我还挺有亲切感的。
LOC_EVENT_COMPETITOR_BIRTH_COMMENT.en: Truth be told, pretending everything is fine while the room burns feels weirdly familiar to me.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_POSITIV.source: 看穿结尾也能继续参与这套共同仪式
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_POSITIV.zh_CN: 明知道最后一句肯定要讨顿饭钱，还是忍不住想看他前半段能编得多离谱
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_POSITIV.en: Even knowing the last line is going to beg for lunch money, I still click in to see how unhinged the first half gets

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_NEGATIV.source: 前面拯救世界，最后借我一顿饭钱
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_NEGATIV.zh_CN: 前面还在外太空拯救人类呢，图穷匕见就为了让我请顿星期四炸鸡
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_NEGATIV.en: Paragraph one is out in deep space saving humanity and the grand finale is hitting me up for Thursday fried chicken

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_TITLE.zh_CN: 用户每逢周四发离奇长故事并在末尾讨餐费
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_TITLE.en: Users post outrageous Thursday stories ending with meal-money requests

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_NARRATI.source: %s用户开始在星期四发布离奇长故事，末尾突然请求一小笔餐费。读者即使看穿结尾，也继续帮故事补上更夸张的前半段。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_NARRATI.zh_CN: %s每逢周四就有大批网友编出跌宕起伏的长段子，直到最后一行才图穷匕见讨顿炸鸡钱。看客哪怕早猜到了底牌，还是乐此不疲地帮着把前半截编得更悬乎。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_NARRATI.en: Every Thursday in %s, crowds of users spin wild, twisting long-form tales that wait until the very last line to drop the act and ask for fried-chicken money. Readers know the punchline by heart and still pitch in to make the opening half even taller.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_COMMENT.source: 预期中的转折，也能成为参与的理由。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_COMMENT.zh_CN: 明明翻第一行就知道结尾要讨饭钱，大家居然还能配合着演完一整楼。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REPLY_COMMENT.en: Everyone knows from line one that it ends by asking for lunch money, yet the whole thread still plays along to the bottom.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_POSIT.source: 时间对照让个人经历容易被别人理解
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_POSIT.zh_CN: 刚搬进来和住满一年的照片往一块儿一摆，不用多写字就能看出日子怎么过的
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_POSIT.en: Put move-in day next to one year later and two pictures tell how life has been going without a single extra word

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_NEGAT.source: 计划书还在发光，现实已经开始漏雨
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_NEGAT.zh_CN: 连晒生活落差的两格图都被商家拿去吹产品升级了，广告真是无孔不入
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_NEGAT.en: Even a two-panel joke for laughing at our own rough year got hijacked by brands bragging about product upgrades; ads really get into everything

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_TITLE.source: “开始时／现在”的双图对照流行
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_TITLE.zh_CN: 开始与现状并排的双图模板从日常晒图传到商家
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_TITLE.en: Start-versus-now photo pairing spreads from personal posts to product redesigns

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_NARRA.source: %s用户把搬家、求职和旅行的开始与现状并排发布。同一件事前后的两张照片成了通用模板，商家也开始用它展示产品改版。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_NARRA.zh_CN: %s不少网友把刚搬家、刚找工作或刚出门旅行时的照片与眼下的狼狈模样并排晒出，这种“刚开始／现在”双格图很快火出圈，连商家都借去晒自家的产品改版。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_NARRA.en: Users in %s post side-by-side shots of day one of a move, job hunt or trip next to their bedraggled present selves. This 'How it started / How it's going' two-panel format breaks out fast, with businesses borrowing it to show off product updates.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_COMME.source: 同一主体前后的差别，比两张无关图片更能留住含义。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_COMME.zh_CN: 连品牌官号都学会拿它发海报了，离大家看腻也就不远了。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT_PAIR_COMME.en: Once official brand accounts learn how to put it on posters, everyone getting sick of it isn't far behind.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_POSI.source: 反着说的感谢让压力有了共同表达
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_POSI.zh_CN: 不好当面翻脸的时候甩一句拉长音的“栓Q”，群里谁都能听出那股咬牙切齿的劲儿
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_POSI.en: When you can't blow up to someone's face, a drawn-out 'Shuan Q' lets everyone in the group chat hear your teeth grinding

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_NEGA.source: 谢谢你，我的休息时间已经没有意见了
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_NEGA.zh_CN: 嘴上阴阳怪气发了一百句栓Q，手里的临时加班和加量作业还是一样没少干
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_NEGA.en: Typed a hundred sarcastic Shuan Qs in the chat and still had to finish every scrap of surprise overtime and extra homework

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_TITL.zh_CN: 上班族与学生用“栓Q”回应临时加班和追加作业
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_TITL.en: Workers and students answer surprise overtime and extra homework with 'Shuan Q'

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_NARR.source: %s上班族开始用“栓Q”回应临时加班通知，语音里夸张的感谢与截图中的新任务形成反差。学生也借来回应突然追加的作业。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_NARR.zh_CN: %s上班族流行起拿一句腔调夸张的“栓Q”配上下班前突袭的派活截图，很快连学生群也跟着借去应付临时加塞的周末作业。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_NARR.en: Office workers in %s take to pairing an exaggerated 'Shuan Q' thank-you with screenshots of last-minute tasks dropped right before quitting time, and student chats soon borrow it for surprise weekend homework.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_COMM.source: 感谢的字面没有变，语境把方向翻了过去。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_COMM.zh_CN: 字面上还是句谢谢，挑不出毛病。人在不能直接翻脸的时候总是很有办法。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_ROSTER_STANCE_COMM.en: On paper it's still a thank-you, so nobody can fault your manners. People get remarkably inventive when they aren't allowed to lose their temper.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_POSITIV.source: 简短暗号让赞美能迅速跟上现场节奏
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_POSITIV.zh_CN: 比赛翻盘那一下根本来不及打长句，四个字母刷出去全场气氛就接上了
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_POSITIV.en: When a match flips in the final seconds there's no time for full sentences; four letters fill the screen and the whole crowd's right there with you

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_NEGATIV.source: 永远的神也开始负责推荐午饭
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_NEGATIV.zh_CN: 昨天拿来夸绝杀夺冠，今天连食堂阿姨多给半勺肉都能封个神
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_NEGATIV.en: Yesterday it crowned a buzzer-beater champion, today the canteen lady adding half a spoon of meat gets called god-tier too

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_TITLE.zh_CN: “YYDS”从赛事直播间扩散到日常夸赞
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_TITLE.en: 'YYDS' spreads from sports streams to actors, restaurants, and everyday errands

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_NARRATI.source: %s赛事直播观众把“YYDS”刷给逆转取胜的选手，随后粉丝将这四个字母用在演员、饭馆和一次顺利办完的手续上。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_NARRATI.zh_CN: %s赛事直播间里刷给翻盘选手的满屏“YYDS”一路火到场外，从喜欢的演员、街角小馆子到一趟没排队的办事窗口，什么都能顺嘴封上一句。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_NARRATI.en: Screens full of 'YYDS' spammed for a comeback winner in %s's match streams spill out everywhere, crowning favorite actors, corner noodle shops and even a service counter with no queue.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_COMMENT.source: 暗号保持不变，赞美的对象会不断换人。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 什么都能封神的结果，就是“神”这个字贬值得特别快。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_SPORT_WAVE_COMMENT.en: Crown everything god-tier and 'god' loses its exchange rate pretty fast.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_POSI.source: 把双方所得并列能让隐含条件变得清楚
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_POSI.zh_CN: 把岗位要求拆成“我得到／你得到”两栏一对，画大饼的招聘启事当场就露馅了
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_POSI.en: Split a job post into 'I receive / You receive' columns and all those grand promises fall apart on the spot

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_NEGA.source: 我得到工作，你得到我的全部时间
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_NEGA.zh_CN: 我得到一份微薄底薪，你得到我二十四小时随叫随到，这笔买卖看着就眼熟
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_NEGA.en: I receive base pay that barely covers rent, you receive me on call twenty-four hours a day; somehow that deal looks awfully familiar

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_TITL.source: “交易提议”模板进入求职讨论
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_TITL.zh_CN: “交易提议”双栏从求职讨论延伸到情侣与玩家
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_TITL.en: Job seekers, couples, and gamers adopt two-column 'Trade Offer' format

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_NARR.source: %s求职社区使用“我得到／你得到”的交易提议双栏，逐项拆开招聘广告。情侣与游戏玩家也开始用相同布局交换条件。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_NARR.zh_CN: %s求职论坛流行起“我得到／你得到”双栏交易图，专门把长篇招聘启事里的漂亮话拆成赤裸裸的交换清单，随后连情侣约法三章和游戏组队也照搬了同一套版式。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_NARR.en: Job forums in %s latch onto two-column 'I receive / You receive' trade-offer graphics that strip flowery job listings down to blunt give-and-take lists, before couples negotiating house rules and game squads adopt the exact same layout.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_COMM.source: 两边的条件可以夸张，交换关系必须还能看懂。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_COMM.zh_CN: 把修饰词全删掉，只列两边各自拿什么。很多漂亮的提议确实经不起这么摆。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_RULE_REVERSAL_COMM.en: Strip out all the adjectives and just list what each side walks away with. Plenty of handsome offers don't survive being laid out like that.

LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_POSITIVE.source: 翻译保留了语境，陌生读者也能接上同一句话
LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 不光翻了字面意思，连什么场合该怎么接话都举了例，隔壁语种的人一下就玩起来了
LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_POSITIVE.en: They didn't stop at translating the words, they threw in sample replies for real chats and the next language over picked it right up

LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_NEGATIVE.source: 字面可以翻过去，生活经验未必一起过去
LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 词是硬翻过去了，没过过同一种苦日子的人怕是很难笑到一块儿去
LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_NEGATIVE.en: You can wrestle the words into another language, sure, though folks who haven't lived the same grind probably won't laugh in the same place

LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_TITLE.source: 网友将这条模因译入另一语言社群
LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_TITLE.zh_CN: 双语网友附带例句将模因搬进外语社群
LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_TITLE.en: Bilingual user brings meme into foreign-language chat with sample replies

LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_NARRATIVE.source: %s一位双语用户给这条模因补上译文和使用场景，转发到另一语言社群。新读者沿用原本的指向，也开始在本地话题下接话。
LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s一位双语网友把这条模因翻成外语，还顺手配了几段日常聊天里怎么接茬的例句，转进另一语言社群。那边的新面孔很快摸清了用法，已经在本地帖子底下跟着玩起来了。
LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_NARRATIVE.en: A bilingual user in %s translates the meme into another language alongside a few sample exchanges showing when to drop it in everyday chat. Newcomers over there pick up the hang of it fast and start riffing on it under local threads.

LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_COMMENT.source: 跨语言传播先解决谁能看懂，再解决谁愿意接。
LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 不仅帮忙翻译，还附赠了例句。这种免费的跨国宣传员可不多见。
LOC_EVENT_CROSS_LANGUAGE_COMMENT.en: Translated it for free and threw in sample sentences too. Unpaid international publicists like that are hard to come by.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.source: 清晰的来源让新观众容易找到原作
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.zh_CN: 百万粉大号转帖还老老实实留了原作者和链接，顺着摸过来的人一下多了好几倍
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.en: A million-follower account reposted it with both the author's name and source link intact, sending way more people back to the original

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.source: 转发者的口吻也可能盖过作者的本意
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.zh_CN: 大号置顶是带火了，就是现在外人提起来全以为是他家的梗
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.en: Pinning it on a giant account blew it up, alright, except outsiders bring it up now like that account wrote it

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.source: 百万关注账号保留署名转发
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.zh_CN: 百万粉评论号带署名与原链接置顶转发
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.en: Million-follower commentary account pins repost with author credit and source link

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.source: %s拥有百万关注的评论账号转发这条模因，保留作者署名与原始链接，并把相关讨论置顶。大量新读者第一次接触到它。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.zh_CN: %s一个坐拥百万粉丝的评论大号转发了这条模因，不仅留着原作者署名和出处链接，还把整串讨论置顶挂在主页，引来大波头一回见它的新看客。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.en: A commentary account with a million followers in %s reposts the meme with the original author credit and source link intact, pinning the whole thread at the top of its profile and drawing waves of first-time readers.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.source: 署名与链接把注意力接回了原来的作品。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.zh_CN: 既是你的光荣榜，也是你的通缉令……
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CREDIT_PRESERVED_.en: Part hall of fame, part wanted poster…

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_POSI.source: 重复的结构让新人一眼看出如何加入
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_POSI.zh_CN: 每层楼只换一件鸡毛蒜皮的小事，路人刷到首页瞄两眼就会跟着往下接了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_POSI.en: Each reply only swaps in one tiny everyday annoyance, so passersby on the home feed catch on after two lines and jump right in

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_NEGA.source: 同一串回复也会让旁观者很快感到重复
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_NEGA.zh_CN: 一模一样的句式盖了几百层楼，刚开始还觉得逗，往下划三屏就审美疲劳了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_NEGA.en: Hundreds of replies in the exact same sentence frame; funny at first, exhausting three screens down

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_TITL.source: 网友用同一句式发起接龙
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_TITL.zh_CN: 社群发起日常小事接龙，帖子冲上首页
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_TITL.en: Community reply chain of small daily gripes climbs onto front page

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_NARR.source: %s一个社群用这条模因发起接龙，每个回复换一件日常小事。首页推荐把整串讨论推给原社群之外的用户。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_NARR.zh_CN: %s一个兴趣社群拿这条模因玩起了盖楼接龙，每层回复各自填进一桩日常小事。整串帖子被推上平台首页后，连圈外的路人也跑来凑热闹往下接。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_NARR.en: An interest community in %s starts a reply chain around the meme, with each floor slotting in one everyday annoyance. Once the thread lands on the platform's front page, passersby from outside the circle jump in to keep it going.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_COMM.source: 接龙把阅读变成了一次低成本的参与。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_COMM.zh_CN: 我刚才顺手翻了一下，第三百多层居然还有人在认真往下接。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_ANSWER_CHAIN_COMM.en: I scrolled through it just now, and people past floor three hundred are still adding replies in earnest.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_POS.source: 范例补上了新人缺少的共同经验
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_POS.zh_CN: 有人好心列了三个现成例子，平时光窥屏不吭声的人这下也知道怎么下嘴了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_POS.en: Someone kindly laid out three ready-made examples, so lurkers who usually never type a word finally know how to jump in

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_NEG.source: 范例也可能把宽泛的用法固定成标准答案
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_NEG.zh_CN: 本来怎么瞎用都行的梗，让人列成一二三条用法说明，看着倒像在做阅读题
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_NEG.en: A joke you could toss around however you liked got numbered one-two-three like a reading-comprehension worksheet

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_TIT.source: 使用范例帮助新读者看懂模因
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_TIT.zh_CN: 热心网友整理三种用法，带动潜水党下场造句
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_TIT.en: Helpful user compiles three ways to use the meme, drawing lurkers in

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_NAR.source: %s一位社区整理者为这条模因补充三种具体用法，逐一展示适合的情境。原先只围观的用户开始照着范例发布自己的版本。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_NAR.zh_CN: %s一位热心做整理的网友给这条模因总结出三种常见用法，挨个标明什么场合甩出来最对味。原本只敢在底下看热闹的潜水用户，也开始照猫画虎发自己的版本。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_NAR.en: A user who likes organizing threads in %s sums up three common ways to use the meme, noting what kind of moment each one fits best. Lurkers who used to stick to watching from the sidelines start copying the examples to post their own.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_COM.source: 看懂用法之后，转述才容易保留原意。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_COM.zh_CN: 笑话一旦配了使用说明书，本身倒是没那么好笑了。好在确实管用。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_USAGE_EXAMPLE_COM.en: A joke loses half its fun once it comes with an instruction manual. Works, though.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.source: 场景示范让表达的指向更容易理解
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.zh_CN: 光看字还没反应过来笑点在哪，听主播对着直播画面念出来一下就对味了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.en: Reading the text cold didn't click until I heard the streamer belt it out over live footage

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.source: 主播的语气可能成为观众唯一记住的版本
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.zh_CN: 切片满天飞，现在不管谁发这句话，我脑子里全是那个主播扯嗓子的动静
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.en: Clips are everywhere now, so no matter who types that line, all I hear in my head is that streamer yelling

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.source: 创作者直播展示模因的用法
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.zh_CN: 主播看片时随口引用模因，录播切片四处流传
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.en: Streamer drops meme on live broadcast as reaction clips spread everywhere

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.source: %s一位视频创作者在直播中用这条模因评论实时画面，切片随后被多个频道搬运。观众通过相同场景反复听见这套表达。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.zh_CN: %s一名人气主播在直播里对着实时画面甩出了这条模因，录屏切片当晚就被好几个搬运号剪出去疯传，不少观众硬是靠这段切片才听懂它原本是什么语气。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.en: A popular streamer in %s tosses out the meme over live footage, and screen-recorded clips get cut and reposted across half a dozen channels the same night, teaching plenty of viewers how the line was meant to sound.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.source: 现场反应替文字补足了语气。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.zh_CN: 现在大家脑子里配的都是那位主播的声音了。这算不算抢了你一半的署名权？
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_WORKSHOP_DEMONSTR.en: Everyone hears it in that streamer's voice now. Does that count as taking half your credit?

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_POS.source: 共同时间把零散用户连成可辨认的群体
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_POS.zh_CN: 每天临近交班刷上一句，隔着屏幕也知道这会儿还有人跟我一块儿熬着
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_POS.en: Dropping this line right before shift handover lets you know across the screen someone else is awake grinding through the same hour

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_NEG.source: 错过那个时段的人不一定理解热闹从何而来
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_NEG.zh_CN: 大白天点进去一头雾水，合着半夜不睡觉的那拨人背着我们有暗号是吧
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_NEG.en: Clicked the tag at noon and couldn't make head or tail of it; so the night owls have a secret handshake behind our backs now

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_TIT.source: 社群在固定时段集中使用模因
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_TIT.zh_CN: 夜班人群每天交班前准点刷梗打卡
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_TIT.en: Night-shift crowd clocks out by posting the meme on the dot every morning

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_NAR.source: %s一个晚班社群开始在交班前集中发布这条模因。固定时段让散落各处的用户互相找到，也让外人注意到这场每天重现的小仪式。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_NAR.zh_CN: %s一拨上夜班的网友养成习惯，每天临近交班就在广场上准点刷出这条模因。原本互不认识的夜猫子靠这声招呼对上了暗号，连白天上网的人也开始好奇半夜这阵动静。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_NAR.en: Night-shift regulars in %s make a habit of posting the meme on the public feed right before handover every day. Strangers up past midnight recognize one another by the greeting, and daytime users start wondering what all the late-night fuss is about.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_COM.source: 传播有时需要的是同一刻，而非更多解释。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_COM.zh_CN: 硬是把你的模因用成了准点下班铃。至少说明它挺有陪伴感的。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_RITUAL_TIMING_COM.en: They turned your meme into a shift-change bell. Says something nice about the company it keeps, at least.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.source: 新的现实让旧表达重新获得用途
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.zh_CN: 当年随手留的一句旧话，搁在眼下这桩事里居然严丝合缝，老帖真给盘活了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.en: An offhand line from way back lines up down to the comma with this week's mess; talk about bringing an old thread back to life

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.source: 旧日期可能被当成预言，也可能被断章取义
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.zh_CN: 截图角落挂个老日期就开始喊神预言，也没人去翻翻人家原帖当初在聊什么
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.en: Slap an old timestamp in the corner and everyone screams prophecy without even checking what the original thread was about

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.source: 一条旧回复被重新翻出
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.zh_CN: 带旧日期的老帖截图被扒出，意外贴合近况翻红
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.en: Dated screenshot dug out of old thread catches fire again for matching today's news

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.source: %s网友在回看旧话题时翻出这条模因，发现它刚好贴合当下处境。带日期的截图让新读者加入，老用户也再次开始使用。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.zh_CN: %s有网友考古旧帖时翻出了这条模因，截下来的老日期配上眼下的新闻简直严丝合缝。这张陈年截图很快转遍了首页，连早就不玩它的老用户都忍不住捡回来接着刷。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.en: Users digging through old threads in %s unearth the meme, and its old timestamp lines up almost uncannily with this week's news. The yellowed screenshot sweeps the home feed, tempting retired regulars to pick the joke back up.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.source: 旧表达复活时，带回来的不只是原来的受众。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.zh_CN: 当年随手发的一句话，放上旧日期再看，突然就有了点预言家的味道。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_OLD_REPLY_REVISIT.en: Put an old date under a casual remark from back then and suddenly it reads like prophecy.

LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_POSITIVE.source: 减少重复推荐能给其他作品留出空间
LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 满屏来回刷同一句早看烦了，平台压一压推荐，首页总算能换点新鲜东西
LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_POSITIVE.en: Sick to death of scrolling past the same line twenty times an hour; dialing down its reach finally lets something fresh onto the home page

LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_NEGATIVE.source: 别人替我决定了哪一句话值得说
LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 连大伙儿平时随口接什么梗都要发篇长文定性，未免管得太宽了点
LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_NEGATIVE.en: Writing a whole official essay to lecture people over a casual catchphrase is really reaching

LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_TITLE.source: 官方账号将这条模因定性为烂梗
LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_TITLE.zh_CN: 官方文化号点名痛批烂梗，多家平台下调推荐
LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_TITLE.en: Official cultural account blasts 'trash meme' by name as platforms dial down reach

LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_NARRATIVE.source: %s一个官方文化账号在整治低质内容的说明中点名这条模因，称其“重复、低俗、没有表达价值”。数个平台随即降低相关内容的推荐频率。
LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s一个官方文化账号在清理低质内容的通告里直接点名这条模因，批它“重复、低俗、毫无表达价值”，几家主流平台随后悄悄压低了相关帖子的推荐权重。
LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_NARRATIVE.en: An official cultural account in %s singles out the meme in a cleanup notice on low-grade posts, calling it 'repetitive, vulgar and devoid of expressive value,' and major platforms soon trim recommendation weight on matching threads.

LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_COMMENT.source: 定性会改变可见度，也会改变使用它的立场含义。
LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 被正式点名批评“毫无表达价值”了……这算不算另一种官方认证？
LOC_EVENT_FATIGUE_WAVE_COMMENT.en: Singled out by name as 'devoid of expressive value'… Does that count as an official stamp of recognition too?

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.source: 公开指出冒犯能让被忽略的经验进入讨论
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.zh_CN: 天天拿人家当廉价笑料，这回当事人把话摊开讲清楚，早该划条线了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.en: Turn people into a cheap punchline every day and sooner or later they'll lay it out in black and white; that line was overdue

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.source: 一句玩笑把没有参与的人也算进了代价
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.zh_CN: 本来图一乐的玩笑话，现在好几个版面直接设成违禁词，发都发不出去
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.en: Started out as a harmless laugh and now half a dozen boards put it on the word filter so you can't even post it

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.source: 被指向的群体公开表示受到冒犯
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.zh_CN: 被调侃群体发联名信抗议，多个社区屏蔽相关词条
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.en: Group mocked by meme publishes open letter as boards add word filters

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.source: %s一个被这条模因当作笑点的群体发表联名声明，逐项指出其中让成员感到被贬低的指代。相关社群开始主动屏蔽它。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.zh_CN: %s长期被这条模因拿来开涮的一群人发出联名抗议，把话里让人不舒服的暗讽一条条摆上台面，好几个相关社区的版主随后将它加进了屏蔽词库。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.en: People long used as the butt of the meme in %s publish a joint protest laying out every barbed jab in plain view, prompting moderators on several neighboring boards to add the phrase to their blocklists.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.source: 被拿来当笑点的人，也会决定传播能否继续。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.zh_CN: 被调侃的人认真较起真来了。这下很难再拿“只是开个玩笑”糊弄过去。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_AUDIENCE_REFUSAL_.en: The people on the receiving end decided to get serious. Tough to wave that off with 'just joking' anymore.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.source: 降低刷屏频率能让正常讨论重新出现
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: 照着好心人发的屏蔽词清单设完，点进热搜评论区总算清静多了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: Copied that kind stranger's mute-word list into my settings and trending replies finally feel readable again

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.source: 它已经替所有问题提前交了同一份答卷
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: 不管多严肃的新闻底下都有人在那儿无脑复读这一句，真把人看吐了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: Doesn't matter how grim the news is, somebody underneath is brainlessly pasting this exact line again; I'm sick of looking at it

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.source: 高频重复引发集体厌烦
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: 无关热帖遭模因刷屏，网友互传屏蔽词自救
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: Unrelated top threads flooded with meme spam as users pass around mute lists

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.source: %s多个热门话题被这条模因的重复回复占满，用户开始把“不管说什么都有人刷它”的截图放在一起。屏蔽词建议随之流传。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: %s好几个八竿子打不着的热门话题底下都被这条模因刷了屏，忍无可忍的网友把各路离谱复读截成合集挂出来吐槽，顺带传开了设置屏蔽词的手把手教程。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: Popular threads in %s with zero connection to the joke get flooded wall to wall with the meme, driving fed-up users to post supercuts of tone-deaf replies alongside step-by-step mute-filter guides.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.source: 高曝光不会自动变成持续的好感。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: 火过头就是这个下场，连八竿子打不着的新闻底下都有人在那儿复读……
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: That's what overheating looks like: people parroting it under news that has nothing to do with anything…

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_P.source: 追查出处让隐藏的伤害可以被讨论
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_P.zh_CN: 把最早带火这词的人扒个底朝天也好，免得大伙儿稀里糊涂替烂人扬名
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_P.en: Digging up who popularized it first is fair game; saves the rest of us from accidentally making some creep famous

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.source: 作者的旧话替所有转发者补上了未说的立场
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.zh_CN: 我就随手转个梗图乐呵一下，怎么突然还要替八百年前发帖的人背锅了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.en: I forwarded one funny picture for a laugh and now I'm on the hook for whoever posted it eight hundred years ago?

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_T.zh_CN: 早期玩梗者黑历史被扒，网友争论跟风算不算站队
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_T.en: Early meme booster's ugly past surfaces, splitting users over whether reposting takes sides

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.source: %s网友追出这条模因早期使用者的一段歧视性发言。转发者开始删除旧帖，争论集中在继续使用是否等于认同原作者。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.zh_CN: %s有网友顺藤摸瓜，扒出了最早带火这条模因的人曾发表过歧视言论。不少转发过的人赶紧连夜删帖，评论区正为接着玩梗算不算替那人站台吵成一团。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.en: Internet sleuths in %s trace the meme back to discriminatory remarks made by the user who first pushed it big. Reposters scramble to delete old posts overnight while comment threads brawl over whether using the joke means backing its author.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_C.source: 出处争议会把表达与使用者一起拖进讨论。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_C.zh_CN: 以后谁再转这句话，前面都得先附一段免责声明了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_C.en: Anyone forwarding that line from now on is going to need a disclaimer out front.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 原始记录帮助读者重新判断引用是否准确
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 完整原视频放出来就好办了，断章取义截出来的半句话确实该歇歇了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: Putting the uncut video out settles it; half a sentence snipped out of context really needed to be retired

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 转发速度比看完视频快了太多
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 原片前头铺垫了足足五分钟，哪有截出来的那五秒钟转起来带劲
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: Five minutes of dry setup in the full clip doesn't have half the punch of those five cropped seconds

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 事实核查指出模因引用有误
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 核查账号放出完整原视频，证实模因引语系断章取义
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: Fact-check account posts uncut video showing meme quote was clipped out of context

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: %s事实核查账号公布原始视频，证明这条模因引用的那句话来自另一段情境。纠正链接被放在热门转载下，部分读者停止使用原版本。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: %s一个事实核查账号放出了未剪辑的原始录像，证实这条模因里疯传的那句话其实截自完全相反的上下文。核查链接被刷上热转前排后，不少人默默停用了原版。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: A fact-checking account in %s posts the unedited source video, showing the viral line inside the meme was snipped out of the exact opposite point.
