Once the correction climbs to the top of major reposts, plenty of users drop the original version without a word.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 具体的更正会改变具体的信任。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 真相终于追上来了，虽然已经跑完了大半个地球……
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: The truth finally caught up, even if the rumor already lapped half the planet…

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_POSITIVE.source: 相同形式也能表达相反立场
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 一字不改照抄他们当初吹牛的原话，底下直接换上翻车现场，杀人诛心不过如此
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_POSITIVE.en: Copying their old boasts word for word over footage of the whole thing crashing and burning is ice-cold perfection

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NEGATIVE.source: 曾经表示支持的一句话成了对支持者的回敬
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 当初真心实意拿来加油打气的一句话，现在硬生生给他们玩成了阴阳怪气的脏词
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NEGATIVE.en: A line people once used in earnest to cheer each other on got twisted into a sneering insult

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_TITLE.source: 批评者借用这条模因反讽原来的支持者
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_TITLE.zh_CN: 批评者照搬模因原话，换上翻车画面反向嘲讽
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_TITLE.en: Critics keep meme wording word for word, swapping in failure clips to mock it

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NARRATIVE.source: %s一个批评者社群保留这条模因的句式，把它放到与原支持对象相反的画面上。新版本仍能被认出来，赞同的口吻却成了嘲讽。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s一拨唱反调的网友原封不动留着这条模因的句式，偏偏把底图全换成了与原意唱反调的翻车现场。话还是那句熟话，听在耳朵里却全成了阴阳怪气。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NARRATIVE.en: Contrarian posters in %s keep the meme's sentence pattern untouched while swapping the background for footage of things going spectacularly wrong. Every word is the same familiar line, yet in the ear it lands as pure sarcasm.

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_COMMENT.source: 认得出原句，反转才会产生力量。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 一个字都没改你的，光换张图意思就彻底反过来了。语境这东西真不讲道理。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_COMMENT.en: Didn't change a single word of yours, swapped one picture underneath, and flipped the meaning upside down. Context really doesn't play fair.

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_POSITIVE.source: 新的经验能让既有形式长出新的用途
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 管它最早是聊什么的，拿来形容咱们这摊破事反正再贴切不过了
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_POSITIVE.en: Who cares what it originally meant; nothing sums up our own mess half as neatly as this line

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NEGATIVE.source: 所有人都在用同一句话，却未必在说同一件事
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 满屏刷的还是同一句话，点进去一看，新来这帮人聊的跟我们压根不是一码事
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NEGATIVE.en: Everyone's typing the exact same sentence on my feed, then I click in and the new crowd isn't even talking about the same thing

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_TITLE.source: 新的社群给这条模因赋予另一层含义
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_TITLE.zh_CN: 新圈子借走模因另起炉灶，新老受众各聊各话
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_TITLE.en: Outside circle borrows meme for its own gripes as old and new crowds talk past each other

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NARRATIVE.source: %s一个新接触到这条模因的社群，用它谈论原作没有涉及的生活经验。旧用户仍看得懂表面表达，双方对它所指的事情开始分歧。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s另一个圈子的网友把这条模因捡去吐槽他们自己的日常，跟最早那拨人聊的事压根不挨边。现在两边嘴里挂着同一句话，心里想的却早已是两码事了。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NARRATIVE.en: Another circle of users in %s picks up the meme to complain about their own routines, miles away from what the first crowd meant. Both sides now repeat the exact same sentence with completely different things in mind.

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_COMMENT.source: 语义分叉发生在共同形式仍然存在的时候。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_COMMENT.zh_CN: 两边嘴里说的是同一句话，聊上三句才发现压根不在一个频道……
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_COMMENT.en: Both sides are saying the exact same sentence, and three replies in they realize they aren't even on the same channel…

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 新的措辞让原本不熟悉句式的人也能看懂
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 把绕来绕去的原句拆成一句大白话，没追过前情的人一眼也能看明白在吵什么
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Unpacking that tangled original sentence into plain talk lets anyone walking in late see what the fight is about right away

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 意思还在，熟悉的那句话已经不在了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 大白话是好懂了，原先那句拐着弯儿的灵魂腔调也跟着一块儿没了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Plain talk is easier to follow, sure, except the roundabout cadence that gave the line its soul went right out the window

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 网友用直白的说法转述这条模因
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 网友抛开原句改用大白话转述，新说法反客为主
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Users ditch original phrasing for plain-spoken recap, and the paraphrase takes over

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: %s网友把这条模因转述成一段直接的说明，不再沿用原有句式。新读者能理解同一层意思，却开始用这套新措辞继续接话。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: %s有网友嫌原句绕口，干脆用一段直白的大白话把里头的意思重讲了一遍。后进来的路人不用补课也能听懂，索性都顺着这句新编的大白话接着往下聊了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Finding the original line a mouthful, users in %s restate the point in plain, everyday language instead. Latecomers understand it without any homework and carry the thread forward using the new paraphrase.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 表达换了一套说法，指向仍然可以保持。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 精心设计的原句没人记，省事的转述版倒传开了。做这行经常得接受这种事。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Nobody remembers the carefully crafted original, while the lazy paraphrase goes everywhere. You make peace with that a lot in this job.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 换一种说法也能把同一意思传给新人
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 换成咱们圈里顺嘴的黑话一讲，群里那帮熟人秒懂，比原话带感多了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: Put it in our own circle's slang and the regulars get it in half a second, way punchier than the original

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 原作与复述听起来不同，指向却仍然相同
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 被他们改成圈内黑话单飞出去之后，现在谁还记得最早是从哪句梗变来的
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: Once they spun it off in insider lingo, nobody out there remembers which meme it hatched from anymore

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 社群开始用自己的说法复述模因
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 小圈子用自家黑话重编模因，新说法脱离原作单飞
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: Niche circle rewrites meme in its own slang as new phrasing breaks away solo

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: %s一个兴趣社群把这条模因的意思用自己的说法重新讲了一遍。原来的表达被替换，大家仍围绕同一层含义接话，新措辞开始单独流传。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: %s一个兴趣小圈子把这条模因的意思揉进了自家的行话里重说了一遍，聊的还是那档子事，嘴里的词却全换了茬，这套新说法眼下已经脱离原帖单独传开了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: A tight hobby circle in %s folds the meme's point into its own slang: the topic stays the same while every word swaps out, and the new phrasing has now broken loose from the original post to circulate on its own.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 同一个意思，可能留下几种不同的表达。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 全换成了圈内黑话，连我都快认不出这是你原来的项目了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: Swapped head to toe into insider slang. Even I can barely tell this started as your project.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_P.source: 新的场景让形式获得了另一种可用的含义
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_P.zh_CN: 管它原帖前头写了什么，单截这一句出来怼对面那帮人简直百发百中
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_P.en: Who cares what the rest of the post said; cropping this one line out hits the other camp dead center

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.source: 没有变的字句也能被搬去指认别的人
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.zh_CN: 让营销号掐头去尾截剩半张图，好端端一句话硬是给当成了地图炮
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.en: Clout accounts chopped off the top and bottom of the screenshot and turned a normal sentence into a blanket attack

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_T.source: 脱离原场景的转载改变了指向
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_T.zh_CN: 营销号掐头去尾搬运截图，模因被当成站队新靶子
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_T.en: Repost account crops out context, turning meme into fresh factional ammo

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.source: %s一个搬运账号裁掉这条模因原有的前后文，把剩下的部分用在完全不同的争论里。新读者将它当成对另一群体的评价。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.zh_CN: %s一个搬运号把这条模因前后的铺垫全给裁没了，单拎出中间半句丢进了另一场毫不相干的骂战里，不明真相的路人当场把它认成了嘲讽另一群人的地图炮。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.en: A repost account in %s trims off all the setup before and after the meme, tossing the bare middle line into an unrelated flame war where passersby mistake it for a swipe at another group altogether.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_C.source: 语境被剪掉以后，剩下的空位会有人填上。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_C.zh_CN: 前后铺垫全被截掉了。在截图时代，把话说完整好像也没什么安全感。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_C.en: Every bit of setup got cropped off. Writing complete sentences doesn't buy much safety in the age of screenshots.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_PO.source: 熟悉的地方经验为表达提供新的共同理解
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_PO.zh_CN: 借这词来叫咱们本地这摊烂摊子太顺嘴了，省得每次都要从头解释半天
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_PO.en: Borrowing this word for our own local mess rolls right off the tongue and saves ten minutes of explaining every time

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NE.source: 名字借来了，原来那件事已经不在场
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NE.zh_CN: 传到他们本地人嘴里全变味了，早没人记得这词当初是专指哪桩事的了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NE.en: Locals chewed the term beyond recognition; nobody remembers the one specific story it originally pointed to

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_TI.source: 本地社群用模因给自己的处境命名
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_TI.zh_CN: 地方社区借模因吐槽本地顽疾，专指旧梗变成日常泛称
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_TI.en: Local forum adopts meme for neighborhood headaches, turning specific joke into catch-all slang

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NA.source: %s一个地方社群用本地经验重新解释这条模因。原来的对象变成泛指，大家开始用它描述一种相似却不相同的处境。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NA.zh_CN: %s一个地方论坛把这条模因拿去套用自家的日常槽点。叫得久了，早先特指那桩事的名字彻底变成了当地人的口头泛称，但凡碰上差不多的糟心场面都能拿它顶一句。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NA.en: A local board in %s drafts the meme into service for chronic neighborhood gripes. Over time, a name coined for one specific incident turns into an all-purpose local sigh dropped whenever things go sideways.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_CO.source: 本地化有时会连同指向一起改写。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_CO.zh_CN: 从专有名词混成了当地人的日常叹词。虽然意思淡了点，好歹是算扎根了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_CO.en: Started as a proper noun and ended up a local sigh. Thinned the meaning out a bit, though at least it put down roots.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_P.source: 共同使用让个人经历有了稳定的表达搭配
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_P.zh_CN: 每次发加班餐和绩效表顺手配一句它，不用多吐半个脏字同事就懂了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_P.en: Toss this line onto a late-night takeout photo or a ranking sheet and coworkers get the message without a single swear word

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.source: 原来的意思被每次一起出现的抱怨拉走了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.zh_CN: 硬是被打工人跟加班表焊死在一块儿了，现在在别的地方发这句都串味
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.en: Office workers welded it so tight to overtime sheets that using the line anywhere else tastes like fluorescent lights now

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_T.source: 这条模因与职场梗形成固定搭配
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_T.zh_CN: 打工人高频混搭加班与绩效吐槽，模因被焊死在职场语境
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_T.en: Office workers pair meme nonstop with overtime gripes, locking it into workplace talk

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.source: %s上班族反复把这条模因与加班、绩效排名的表达放在一起使用。新读者逐渐把原本宽泛的句式理解成对职场规则的评价。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.zh_CN: %s大批上班族一晒加班记录和末位淘汰表就顺手带上这条模因。见得次数多了，后来的网友干脆把它当成了专门阴阳职场考勤的固定台词。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.en: Crowds of office workers in %s tack the meme onto every screenshot of late-night clock-outs and stack-ranking charts. After enough rounds, newer users take it as a stock jab reserved strictly for workplace attendance rules.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_C.source: 经常相邻的表达，会开始分享同一层含义。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_C.zh_CN: 现在我一看见这句话，都会条件反射想看一眼下班时间。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_C.en: Every time I see that line now, I catch myself glancing at the clock to check quitting time.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 互相引用让两种表达共享新的联想
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 两张毫不相干的老梗拼在一个视频里意外地搭，现在刷出前半句底下全在默契接下联
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Two unrelated old jokes spliced into one clip fit like a glove; type the first half now and the replies finish the couplet on cue

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 拆开任意一边，观众仍会自动补上另一边
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 硬跟那套对比图绑成了连体婴，想单独发一句都躲不开底下跟风补下半截的
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Welded together like conjoined twins with that comparison meme; you can't even post one line solo without twenty people finishing the other half

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 两套梗被剪进同一个对照模板
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 创作者将两套梗混剪成连体搭档，刷半句自动带出下半截
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Creators splice two memes into an inseparable pair; half a line summons the rest

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: %s创作者把这条模因与另一套“前后对照”的表达并排剪辑。多次转载后，观众开始用其中任意半句唤起整个组合。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: %s不少二创作者把这条模因和另一套流行的“前后对比”梗并排剪进同一个视频。来回搬运多了以后，现在评论区只要有人敲出前半句，楼下不用约就会整整齐齐补上另一半。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Remixers in %s edit the meme side by side into clips with a popular before-and-after joke. After enough reposts back and forth, typing the opening half in any comment section brings a neat chorus completing the other half underneath.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 合流需要反复共现，单次拼贴还不够。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 硬是被凑成了固定搭配，连分开单独出场都难了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Matched up into a fixed comedy duo now. Good luck getting either one onstage solo again.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_POSIT.source: 共同暗号让退出争论不必重新解释
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_POSIT.zh_CN: 评论区碰到胡搅蛮缠的人懒得多费唾沫，甩出这句带尾巴的暗号直接体面退场
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_POSIT.en: When someone in the replies won't quit pestering you, dropping this line with its parting tag lets you walk away clean

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NEGAT.source: 接话的邀请也被改写成了不想再接话
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NEGAT.zh_CN: 以前发出来是找人一块儿聊天的，现在倒好，谁发这句就等于直接把门摔上了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NEGAT.en: Used to be how you started a friendly chat, and now whoever types it might as well be slamming the door shut

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_TITLE.source: 新的收尾句把模因变成退出暗号
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_TITLE.zh_CN: 网友给模因接上固定散场句，吵架太累时拿来关麦走人
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_TITLE.en: Users tack fixed sign-off onto meme, using it to bow out of exhausting threads

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NARRA.source: %s网友给这条模因加上一句固定收尾，在争论太久时用它表示不再继续。原本引人接话的表达开始承担结束对话的功能。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NARRA.zh_CN: %s网友给这条模因后头续上了一句固定的送客话，专门留着在评论区拉扯太久、懒得再吵的时候甩出来封口。原先招人接茬的开场白，就这么变成了关麦散场的信号。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NARRA.en: Users in %s graft a set parting line onto the end of the meme, saving it for comment wars that have dragged on past anyone's patience. An icebreaker built to invite replies turns into the signal for switching off the mic.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_COMME.source: 收尾改变了这句话在对话里的用途。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_COMME.zh_CN: 从开场白变成了送客话。毕竟在网上，结束对话可比开始对话难多了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_COMME.en: Went from an icebreaker to a door-closer. Online, ending a conversation is always harder than starting one.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_NARRATIVE.source: 第三次世界大战爆发。人口急剧减少，三天内将无人存活。投放与编辑已停止。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 第三次世界大战爆发。各国人口骤减，整张地图将在三天内彻底归于死寂，投放与编辑已全部停止。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_NARRATIVE.en: World War III has broken out. Populations across every country plunge, the entire map will fall dead silent within three days, and deployment and editing have come to a halt.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_COMMENT.source: 先看仍有人生活的地方；模因需要有人接住。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 机器都安静下来了……趁地图上还有灯亮着，最后再看一眼吧。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_COMMENT.en: Even the machines have gone quiet… Take one last look while a few lights are still on across the map.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_NARRATI.source: 港口译员把同一份船期译成几种版本，随信夹来一本日常短语册。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_NARRATI.zh_CN: 港口译员把同一份船期译成几种版本，随信夹来一本日常短语册。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_NARRATI.en: Harbor interpreters circulate several versions of the sailing schedule, with a pocket phrasebook enclosed.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_NARRAT.source: 车站把旧广播录音整理上网。认出家乡口音的乘客逐句补上字幕。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_NARRAT.zh_CN: 车站把旧广播录音整理上网。认出家乡口音的乘客逐句补上字幕。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_NARRAT.en: An old station uploads its announcements. Passengers recognize familiar accents and supply the missing captions.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_NARRAT.source: 流动图书车驶进山谷，读者在借书单背面写下常用的问候。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_NARRAT.zh_CN: 流动图书车驶进山谷，读者在借书单背面写下常用的问候。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_NARRAT.en: A library van reaches the valley. Readers fill the backs of loan slips with everyday greetings.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_NARRAT.source: 几座岛上的渔民合印潮汐表，给各港口的地名加上当地读音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_NARRAT.zh_CN: 几座岛上的渔民合印潮汐表，给各港口的地名加上当地读音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_NARRAT.en: Fishers print a shared tide table, adding local pronunciations beside each harbor name.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_NAR.source: 夜班长途车上，乘客争着教司机念对新站名，录音在沿线流传。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_NAR.zh_CN: 夜班长途车上，乘客争着教司机念对新站名，录音在沿线流传。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_NAR.en: Passengers on the night coach teach the driver the new stop names. Their recording travels along the route.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_NARRAT.source: 渡轮恢复通航，售票员把两岸乘客常问的话写成了小册。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_NARRAT.zh_CN: 渡轮恢复通航，售票员把两岸乘客常问的话写成了小册。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_NARRAT.en: Ferry services resume. Ticket clerks compile a booklet of questions heard on both shores.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_NARRAT.source: 水井修好后，工匠寄来一封答谢信，信旁逐行标着读音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_NARRAT.zh_CN: 水井修好后，工匠寄来一封答谢信，信旁逐行标着读音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_NARRAT.en: After repairing the well, its builders send a thank-you letter with pronunciation notes in the margin.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_NARRA.source: 沿海小影院征集本地方言配音，一段对白引来许多版本。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_NARRA.zh_CN: 沿海小影院征集本地方言配音，一段对白引来许多版本。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_NARRA.en: A small cinema invites local voice-overs. One exchange acquires a surprising number of versions.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_NARRA.source: 网络词典开放编辑。几位常客为一句招呼的语气争论到深夜。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_NARRA.zh_CN: 网络词典开放编辑。几位常客为一句招呼的语气争论到深夜。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_NARRA.en: An online dictionary opens to contributions. Regular editors debate the tone of a greeting late into the night.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_NARR.source: 河谷的工坊联印学徒手册，把口授多年的步骤记了下来。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_NARR.zh_CN: 河谷的工坊联印学徒手册，把口授多年的步骤记了下来。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_NARR.en: Workshops publish an apprentice handbook, writing down instructions passed on by ear for years.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_NARRAT.source: 说书人带来一段祖辈传下的故事，听众把最喜欢的句子抄在票根上。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_NARRAT.zh_CN: 说书人带来一段祖辈传下的故事，听众把最喜欢的句子抄在票根上。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_NARRAT.en: A storyteller performs an inherited tale. Listeners copy favorite lines onto their tickets.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_NARR.source: 街坊会议录音公开后，志愿者做出带停顿标记的逐字稿。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_NARR.zh_CN: 街坊会议录音公开后，志愿者做出带停顿标记的逐字稿。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_NARR.en: Volunteers transcribe a neighborhood meeting, marking the pauses as carefully as the words.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_NARRA.source: 雨季开学，老师寄来一张双语通知，孩子在边上补满了注音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_NARRA.zh_CN: 雨季开学，老师寄来一张双语通知，孩子在边上补满了注音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_NARRA.en: School opens in the rainy season. A bilingual notice arrives covered in a child’s pronunciation notes.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_NARRATI.source: 考试前的自习室里，一句吐槽从桌角传到了班级群。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_NARRATI.zh_CN: 考试前的自习室里，一句吐槽从桌角传到了班级群。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_NARRATI.en: Before the exams, a scribbled complaint makes its way from a desk corner to the class chat.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_NAR.source: 演出散场，观众仍在门口交换自己记住的台词。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_NAR.zh_CN: 演出散场，观众仍在门口交换自己记住的台词。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_NAR.en: Outside the theater, the audience keeps trading lines remembered from the performance.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.source: 收购站挂起留言板，种植户在价格表旁写下这季的遭遇。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.zh_CN: 收购站挂起留言板，种植户在价格表旁写下这季的遭遇。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.en: Growers add accounts of their season beside the prices on the collection depot’s noticeboard.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.source: 工人把一道难题画进交接本，下一班接着补全了解法。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.zh_CN: 工人把一道难题画进交接本，下一班接着补全了解法。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.en: A worker sketches a stubborn fault in the handover book. The next shift finishes the solution.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.source: 深夜打烊，店员把顾客的奇怪要求写在作废的小票背面。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.zh_CN: 深夜打烊，店员把顾客的奇怪要求写在作废的小票背面。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.en: At closing time, staff jot down the day’s oddest requests on voided receipts.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_N.source: 诊室开始用一页纸交班。最先被大家记住的，是提醒休息的那句话。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_N.zh_CN: 诊室开始用一页纸交班。最先被大家记住的，是提醒休息的那句话。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_N.en: The clinic adopts a one-page handover. The line everyone remembers is the reminder to take a break.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_NARRAT.source: 备课室传来一张短笺，老师们在上面接着写课堂里的新发现。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_NARRAT.zh_CN: 备课室传来一张短笺，老师们在上面接着写课堂里的新发现。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_NARRAT.en: A note circulates through the staff room. Teachers add discoveries from their classrooms.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_N.source: 街道施工，店主们建群商量送货路线，顺便交换各自的招牌话。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_N.zh_CN: 街道施工，店主们建群商量送货路线，顺便交换各自的招牌话。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_N.en: During roadworks, shopkeepers coordinate deliveries in a new chat and trade their favorite sales pitches.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_NAR.source: 一张深夜故障单附上了极短的注释，早班同事一眼就懂。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_NAR.zh_CN: 一张深夜故障单附上了极短的注释，早班同事一眼就懂。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_NAR.en: A late-night incident ticket carries a very short note. The morning team understands it immediately.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_NARRATI.source: 公园翻修，常坐同一张长椅的人把告示改成了自己的聊天话题。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_NARRATI.zh_CN: 公园翻修，常坐同一张长椅的人把告示改成了自己的聊天话题。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_NARRATI.en: During park repairs, the regulars at one bench turn the closure notice into their morning conversation.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_NARRAT.source: 远方的亲友隔着时差一起做饭，旧称呼和新说法在通话里交错。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_NARRAT.zh_CN: 远方的亲友隔着时差一起做饭，旧称呼和新说法在通话里交错。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_NARRAT.en: Relatives cook together across time zones, mixing old family names with newly learned expressions.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_NARRATI.source: 登记表增加了自填称呼一栏，人们讨论起该如何介绍自己。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_NARRATI.zh_CN: 登记表增加了自填称呼一栏，人们讨论起该如何介绍自己。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_NARRATI.en: A form adds a space for a preferred name. People begin discussing how they introduce themselves.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_NARRATI.source: 字幕组开放校订，一句难译的笑话收到了十几种建议。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_NARRATI.zh_CN: 字幕组开放校订，一句难译的笑话收到了十几种建议。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_NARRATI.en: A captioning team asks for corrections. One difficult joke draws a dozen suggestions.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_NARRATIVE.source: 一则消息反复转发后，最早的发帖人贴出了完整记录。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 一则消息反复转发后，最早的发帖人贴出了完整记录。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_NARRATIVE.en: After a message spreads widely, its first author publishes the complete record.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_NARRATIV.source: 房东重印租约，租客在群里逐条对照新的条款。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_NARRATIV.zh_CN: 房东重印租约，租客在群里逐条对照新的条款。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_NARRATIV.en: A landlord reprints the lease. Tenants compare the revised terms in their chat.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_NARRA.source: 社区诊所更换预约办法，候诊的人互相说明怎样挂上号。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_NARRA.zh_CN: 社区诊所更换预约办法，候诊的人互相说明怎样挂上号。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_NARRA.en: A neighborhood clinic changes its booking system. Patients explain the new procedure to one another.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_NARRATIV.source: 连续几天闷热，居民把窗边的温度读数贴进同一张表。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_NARRATIV.zh_CN: 连续几天闷热，居民把窗边的温度读数贴进同一张表。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_NARRATIV.en: During several muggy days, residents combine the temperatures recorded at their windows.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_NARRATIVE.source: 计划停电的通知贴出来，商户开始安排冰柜和夜间照明。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 计划停电的通知贴出来，商户开始安排冰柜和夜间照明。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_NARRATIVE.en: A power-cut notice goes up. Shopkeepers make arrangements for freezers and evening lights.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_NARRATIVE.source: 市场试吃摊前排起队，不同的家常做法被写在包装纸上。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 市场试吃摊前排起队，不同的家常做法被写在包装纸上。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_NARRATIVE.en: A tasting stall draws a queue. Customers write their own recipes on the wrapping paper.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_NARRAT.source: 末班车调整时刻，晚归的人把新的换乘办法传给同伴。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_NARRAT.zh_CN: 末班车调整时刻，晚归的人把新的换乘办法传给同伴。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_NARRAT.en: The last bus changes its timetable. Late commuters pass around their new connections.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_NARRAT.source: 街坊迎来几户新住户，接待处把常见问题整理成多语便条。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_NARRAT.zh_CN: 街坊迎来几户新住户，接待处把常见问题整理成多语便条。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_NARRAT.en: New households arrive. The welcome desk prepares multilingual notes answering common questions.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_NARRATIV.source: 淡季旅店推出步行地图，住客在背面留下沿途的发现。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_NARRATIV.zh_CN: 淡季旅店推出步行地图，住客在背面留下沿途的发现。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_NARRATIV.en: An inn offers walking maps in the quiet season. Guests record discoveries on the back.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_NARRATIVE.source: 一批货延迟抵港，买卖双方逐行核对货单和承诺的日期。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 一批货延迟抵港，买卖双方逐行核对货单和承诺的日期。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_NARRATIVE.en: A delayed shipment leads buyers and sellers to compare the manifest with the promised dates.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_SCIENCE_NARRATIV.source: 观测站公布一页笔记，爱好者尝试复现其中的测量。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_SCIENCE_NARRATIV.zh_CN: 观测站公布一页笔记，爱好者尝试复现其中的测量。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_SCIENCE_NARRATIV.en: An observatory publishes a page of notes. Enthusiasts try to reproduce its measurements.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CARE_NARRATIVE.source: 邻居排出轮值表，轮流替需要帮助的住户买菜和取药。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CARE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 邻居排出轮值表，轮流替需要帮助的住户买菜和取药。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CARE_NARRATIVE.en: Neighbors arrange turns collecting groceries and medicine for residents who need help.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_NA.source: 一处路口的照明坏了，居民附上夜间照片申请报修。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_NA.zh_CN: 一处路口的照明坏了，居民附上夜间照片申请报修。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_NA.en: Residents submit night photographs to request repairs to the lights at a crossing.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_COMMENT.source: 船期会改，码头上的叫法倒留得久。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_COMMENT.zh_CN: 随信夹来的闲聊小册子，比正经公文管用多了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_COMMENT.en: That pocket booklet of small talk tucked inside the envelope beats any official dispatch.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_COMMEN.source: 听惯的广播，换个人念就觉得路也变了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_COMMEN.zh_CN: 有些声音平时嫌吵，真换掉了反而会突然想念起来。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_COMMEN.en: Funny how you grumble about a noisy station voice every day, then miss it the moment they swap it out.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_COMMEN.source: 借书单背面常有比书目更亲近的话。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_COMMEN.zh_CN: 比起书本身，我其实更爱看上一位借阅者留下的字迹。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_COMMEN.en: Honestly, I enjoy reading the previous borrower's handwriting on the slip more than the book itself.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_COMMEN.source: 有些地名，要出过海才听得出差别。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_COMMEN.zh_CN: 照着标准地图念地名，当地人一听就知道是外地来的。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_COMMEN.en: Read a harbor name straight off a standard map and locals can tell from syllable one that you're from out of town.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_COM.source: 司机学会之前，乘客已经替他报站了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_COM.zh_CN: 就我个人而言，会比较害怕这种场合。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_COM.en: Speaking purely for myself, being stuck on a bus like that sounds terrifying.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_COMMEN.source: 对岸同一句问路，尾音未必一样。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_COMMEN.zh_CN: 被问过太多次同样的问题，逼得售票员自己出书了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_COMMEN.en: Get asked the exact same question enough times and even a ticket clerk ends up publishing a book.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_COMMEN.source: 信上的注音，也记着写信人的耐心。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_COMMEN.zh_CN: 连怎么念都替收信人标好了，真是位体贴的人。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_COMMEN.en: Marking the pronunciation line by line for whoever opens the letter. Thoughtful person.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_COMME.source: 大家笑出声的地方，并不总在同一秒。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_COMME.zh_CN: 换一种方言配音，全场的笑点都不在同一秒了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_COMME.en: Dub the same scene into another dialect and the whole theater laughs on a different beat.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_COMME.source: 一句早上好，也够词典编辑忙上一晚。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_COMME.zh_CN: 在吵出结果之前，他们今晚是没法跟彼此道晚安了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_COMME.en: Until they settle how 'good morning' is supposed to sound, nobody in that thread is saying good night.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_COMM.source: 师傅说得太快的地方，学徒终于有字可查。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_COMM.zh_CN: 总算不用因为没听清，硬着头皮去问前辈第二遍了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_COMM.en: At least apprentices won't have to swallow their pride and ask a senior craftsman to repeat himself anymore.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_COMMEN.source: 票根小，记住的那句倒很长。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_COMMEN.zh_CN: 能让人散场后还想抄在票根上带走，这句词算是活下来了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_COMMEN.en: If a line makes people copy it onto their ticket stubs on the way out, it's earned its keep.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_COMM.source: 停顿也抄下来，才听得见是谁在犹豫。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_COMM.zh_CN: 连犹豫和叹气都会被记下来，以后发言之前真的得三思了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_COMM.en: When even pauses and sighs go into the transcript, you really have to think twice before opening your mouth.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_COMME.source: 孩子的注音，比通知写得密。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_COMME.zh_CN: 页边空白处的批注，有时候比正文更有阅读价值。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_COMME.en: Notes squeezed into the margin are worth more than the main text sometimes.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_COMMENT.source: 能传到别班的便签，通常写得够短。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_COMMENT.zh_CN: 人在不想看书的时候，创造力总是最旺盛的。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_COMMENT.en: Human creativity always peaks right when you're supposed to be studying.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_COM.source: 灯已经关了，台词还在门外接着演。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_COM.zh_CN: 场馆的灯已经关了，门口那场讨论才刚开始。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_COM.en: The house lights are already out, and the real post-show debate by the exit is just getting started.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.source: 价格表只写数字，留言板把那一季补全了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.zh_CN: 光看价格表上的数字，是看不出这一季有多难熬的。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.en: Reading the numbers on a price board alone never tells you how rough the season was.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.source: 交接本翻到最后，常能找到前人的办法。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.zh_CN: 连面都不用见就把问题解了，这是我最理想的同事关系。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.en: Solving the problem without ever having to meet face to face. That's my ideal relationship with coworkers.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.source: 作废的小票，也能把一天记得很准。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.zh_CN: 所以说生活就是艺术的一部分。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.en: Life really is part of art.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_C.source: 交班时能说清的一句话，值一夜安稳。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_C.zh_CN: 越忙的地方，纸上的话越短。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_C.en: The busier the room, the shorter the notes on the page.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_COMMEN.source: 同一节课，隔壁教室可能有另一种讲法。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_COMMEN.zh_CN: 站上讲台这么多年，私底下还是保留着传纸条的习惯。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_COMMEN.en: All those years standing at the podium and they still pass notes on the sly.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_C.source: 送货车绕了路，店主的消息反而走得更近。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_C.zh_CN: 工作群只要建起来了，最后聊的都不是建群时那件事。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_C.en: Once a work chat gets set up, the one thing it never sticks to is why it was created.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_COM.source: 注释短，是因为大家都见过那个故障。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_COM.zh_CN: 半夜三点的故障单，备注越短，写的人当时越崩溃……
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_COM.en: On a 3 a.m. fault ticket, the shorter the note, the closer the author was to losing it…

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_COMMENT.source: 椅子暂时撤走，话题却没少一个。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_COMMENT.zh_CN: 椅子撤走了，人还在老地方。习惯真是种可怕的力量。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_COMMENT.en: The bench is gone and the regulars are still standing on the exact same spot. Habit is a scary thing.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_COMMEN.source: 菜还没出锅，家里的旧称呼已经叫遍了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_COMMEN.zh_CN: 隔着半个地球的时差，一聊起做菜放多少盐，距离好像就消失了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_COMMEN.en: Half a world of time zones melts right away once people start arguing over how much salt goes in the pot.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_COMMENT.source: 表格留白以后，人们才开始认真填名字。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_COMMENT.zh_CN: 幸好我们工作室入职只发代号，省得自己纠结填什么。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_COMMENT.en: Glad our studio just hands out code numbers at onboarding. Saves having to agonize over a blank name box.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_COMMENT.source: 一个笑话译不顺，往往要先问清谁在笑。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 把异国的笑话翻得让人笑出来，本来就比重编一个还难。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_COMMENT.en: Translating a foreign joke so people still laugh is harder than writing a new one from scratch.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_COMMENT.source: 转发走得快，求证总要多走几步。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_COMMENT.zh_CN: 传了一百手之后还能认出原话吗？好在原主自己留了底稿。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_COMMENT.en: Can anyone recognize the original line after a hundred forwards? Good thing the first poster kept receipts.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_COMMENT.source: 租客关心的字，常藏在每页最下面。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_COMMENT.zh_CN: 每次看到“重新修订”四个字，总觉得钱包又要薄一点。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_COMMENT.en: Every time the words 'revised terms' show up on paper, my wallet feels a little thinner.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_COMME.source: 挂号的路讲清了，候诊室就少一点着急。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_COMME.zh_CN: 每次挂号流程升级，最后靠的还是候诊室里的病友互助。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_COMME.en: Every time a clinic upgrades its booking app, patients in the waiting room end up walking each other through it anyway.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_COMMENT.source: 窗边那支温度计，终于有了同伴。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 比起官方报出来的平均气温，大家还是更信自家窗台上的温度计。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_COMMENT.en: Compared with the official citywide average, people always trust the thermometer on their own windowsill more.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_COMMENT.source: 一张停电单，能改掉整条街的晚饭时间。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_COMMENT.zh_CN: 一张薄薄的通知贴出来，整条街今晚的作息就全改了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_COMMENT.en: One thin slip of paper goes up on the wall and the whole street's evening schedule changes.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_COMMENT.source: 同一道菜，排队的人能说出许多来处。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_COMMENT.zh_CN: 只要聊起某道菜该怎么做，排队的人之间就没有秘密可言了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_COMMENT.en: Bring up the right way to cook a dish and strangers in a queue have zero secrets left.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_COMMEN.source: 赶末班车的人，最记得时刻表改了哪一行。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_COMMEN.zh_CN: 时刻表只改了五分钟，对赶末班车的人来说就是回不回得去家的区别。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_COMMEN.en: Five minutes shifted on a timetable is the whole difference between getting home or not when you're chasing the last bus.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_COMMEN.source: 安顿下来之前，总要先问几遍路。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_COMMEN.zh_CN: 比起热情的欢迎词，还是先搞清楚周几倒垃圾更让人安心。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_COMMEN.en: Warm welcome speeches are nice, though learning which day trash goes out puts people at ease faster.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_COMMENT.source: 地图没印出来的小路，住客替它补上了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_COMMENT.zh_CN: 印刷品总是太客气，反倒是前人随手补的那几笔比较值得信。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_COMMENT.en: Printed brochures are always too polite. The penciled notes left by earlier guests are the ones worth trusting.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_COMMENT.source: 等货的时候，日期上的每个字都格外显眼。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 平时谁也不细看的免责条款，这种时候每一个标点都会被拿出来研究。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_COMMENT.en: Nobody reads the fine print in normal weeks, and then a shipment runs late and every comma gets put under a magnifying glass.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_SCIENCE_COMMENT.source: 数据抄下来以后，下一步是自己量一次。

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_HARBOR_ROWING_DERBY_NARR.en: Shipfitters, ferry deckhands and yard dispatchers from three piers in %s field twelve amateur rowboat crews for a low-tide sprint across the inner harbor. Commuters crowd the ferry rails banging thermoses to cheer on whichever boat crew runs their weekday route.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_HARBOR_ROWING_DERBY_COMM.source: 自己天天坐的那班渡轮下水比赛，换谁站在甲板上都得跟着喊两嗓子，哪怕周一早上迟到骂的也是这同一拨开船的。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_HARBOR_ROWING_DERBY_COMM.zh_CN: 周末在岸边给他们加油，也不妨碍周一早高峰照常抱怨船开得慢。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_HARBOR_ROWING_DERBY_COMM.en: Cheering your weekday ferry crew on from the pier all weekend won't stop anyone grumbling when the Monday boat docks slow.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_HARBOR_ROWING_DERBY_POSI.source: 平时天天坐四号码头那班渡轮，看他们划赢了比看职业联赛还来劲

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_HARBOR_ROWING_DERBY_POSI.en: Watching Pier Four's crew pull ahead feels better than any televised league final

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_HARBOR_ROWING_DERBY_NEGA.en: Closing the channel for two hours leaves delivery vans stuck baking on the approach ramp

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_T.en: City hall's standardized bilingual shop signs stir spelling dispute

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_N.source: %s市政厅出资替码头侨民街重做防风店招，却把早年侨民按口音拼写的旧街名一律改成了标准转写。几家开了三代人的杂货铺连夜把拆下来的旧铁牌重新挂回橱窗里头。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_N.zh_CN: %s市政厅出资替码头侨民街重做防风店招，却把早年侨民按口音拼写的旧街名一律改成了标准转写。几家开了三代人的杂货铺连夜把拆下来的旧铁牌重新挂回橱窗里头。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_N.en: City hall in %s funds stormproof shop signs along the harbor migrant quarter, replacing decades-old phonetic spellings with textbook romanization. Several third-generation grocers hang their battered tin signs right back up inside the front window.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_C.source: 新招牌字正腔圆，老主顾抬头却先找橱窗里那块掉漆的旧铁皮，毕竟有些地名一旦改得太标准，听着就像没人住过似的。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_C.zh_CN: 拼写倒是统一标准了，就是住在那儿的人路过得愣一下。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_C.en: The spelling is nice and standardized now, even if people who live on the street have to do a double take walking past.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_P.source: 标上统一转写之后，外地来的邮差和救护车总算不会在巷子里绕晕了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_P.zh_CN: 标上统一转写之后，外地来的邮差和救护车总算不会在巷子里绕晕了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_P.en: Consistent street spellings mean new couriers and ambulance drivers stop circling the wrong alley

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_N.source: 老铁牌上那个歪歪扭扭的旧拼法才是当年下船落脚的记号，改整齐了反倒像连锁商场
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_N.zh_CN: 老铁牌上那个歪歪扭扭的旧拼法才是当年下船落脚的记号，改整齐了反倒像连锁商场
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_BILINGUAL_STREET_SIGNS_N.en: Those crooked old spellings were how our grandparents wrote home from the pier; now the block looks like an airport mall

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_TIT.en: Nine-day heatwave forces factory night shifts and evening brownouts

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_NAR.source: %s连续九天气温突破历史极值，配电网负荷逼近红线。电力公司要求重工业园区改上夜班，并对老旧住宅区实施晚高峰降压供电，五金店里的充电小风扇一晚上卖断了货。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_NAR.zh_CN: %s连续九天气温突破历史极值，配电网负荷逼近红线。电力公司要求重工业园区改上夜班，并对老旧住宅区实施晚高峰降压供电，五金店里的充电小风扇一晚上卖断了货。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_NAR.en: Nine straight days of record heat push %s's power grid to its limit. Utilities move heavy industry onto midnight shifts and lower voltage across older apartment blocks during dinner hours, clearing hardware shelves of rechargeable fans overnight.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_COM.source: 写字楼里开着十九度冷气发倡议书叫大家心静自然凉，老居民楼里的电扇转得跟叹气一样慢……这温度计怕不是装在两个季节里。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_COM.zh_CN: 这种天气晚上降压限电，光靠“心静自然凉”是撑不过去的。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_COM.en: Cutting voltage through dinner hours in weather like this takes more than 'inner peace keeps you cool' to get through.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_POS.source: 先把高耗能厂房挪去半夜开工，总好过整片城区突然拉闸断电
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_POS.zh_CN: 先把高耗能厂房挪去半夜开工，总好过整片城区突然拉闸断电
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_POS.en: Shifting big smelters past midnight beats blowing a transformer and blacking out half the city

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_NEG.source: 老楼一到晚饭点空调就只吹自然风，上夜班的工人白天回宿舍更是热得合不上眼
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_NEG.zh_CN: 老楼一到晚饭点空调就只吹自然风，上夜班的工人白天回宿舍更是热得合不上眼
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_SUMMER_GRID_BROWNOUT_NEG.en: Old flats get warm air out of the AC at suppertime, and night-shift workers can't sleep through noon heat in the dorms

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_TITLE.source: 反常冰雹半小时砸穿河谷成片育苗大棚

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_TITLE.en: Freak spring hailstorm shreds valley greenhouses and young pears

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_NARRAT.source: %s内陆河谷在春播返青期突降鸡蛋大小的冰雹，半小时内砸穿数千亩塑料菜棚与刚挂果的梨园。果农干脆把带雹坑的青梨成筐拉进城里早市，按熬梨膏的原料半价甩卖。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_NARRAT.zh_CN: %s内陆河谷在春播返青期突降鸡蛋大小的冰雹，半小时内砸穿数千亩塑料菜棚与刚挂果的梨园。果农干脆把带雹坑的青梨成筐拉进城里早市，按熬梨膏的原料半价甩卖。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_NARRAT.en: Egg-sized hail batters an inland valley in %s during spring budding, tearing through plastic vegetable tunnels and young pear orchards in half an hour. Growers haul crates of bruised green pears straight to morning markets at half price for jam and syrup.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_COMMEN.source: 半年心血半个钟头就砸成了果酱料，早市上拎两袋便宜梨回家的人心里其实也清楚，下个月菜价准得找补回来。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_COMMEN.zh_CN: 今天早市上的梨有多便宜，下个月的菜价就有多贵。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_COMMEN.en: However cheap those bruised pears are at the morning market today, next month's grocery prices will be just as steep.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_POSITI.source: 满筐带坑的果子熬成梨膏一点不糟蹋，早市大伙儿顺手多拎两袋也算搭把手
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_POSITI.zh_CN: 满筐带坑的果子熬成梨膏一点不糟蹋，早市大伙儿顺手多拎两袋也算搭把手
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_POSITI.en: Bruised pears cook down fine into syrup, and buying two extra bags at the morning stall helps growers clear the trucks

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_NEGATI.source: 农业险定损员光排期下乡就要等半个月，破棚子可等不起下一场冷雨
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_NEGATI.zh_CN: 农业险定损员光排期下乡就要等半个月，破棚子可等不起下一场冷雨
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_ORCHARD_LATE_HAIL_NEGATI.en: Crop-insurance adjusters are booked out for two weeks, and torn greenhouse film won't survive the next cold rain

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_T.source: 罕见平流浓雾迫使海峡客货轮全线停航
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_T.zh_CN: 罕见平流浓雾迫使海峡客货轮全线停航
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_T.en: Three-day sea fog halts all passenger and freight ferries across strait

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_N.source: %s沿海连续三天笼罩在能见度不足五十米的平流浓雾中，跨海渡轮与近海货船全线停航。滞留港口的旅客把候船大厅长椅拼成临时铺位，连离岛报摊上摆的都是三天前的旧日报。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_N.zh_CN: %s沿海连续三天笼罩在能见度不足五十米的平流浓雾中，跨海渡轮与近海货船全线停航。滞留港口的旅客把候船大厅长椅拼成临时铺位，连离岛报摊上摆的都是三天前的旧日报。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_N.en: Advection fog cuts visibility below fifty meters along %s's coast for three days, grounding cross-strait ferries and coastal freighters. Stranded passengers push terminal benches together for beds while island newsstands keep displaying Tuesday's paper.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_C.source: 大雾把船全摁在港里，连岛上报摊卖的都是大前天的旧报纸……难得有这么几天，满城人不用追着新消息跑。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_C.zh_CN: 连续三天没有新消息进来……听起来还挺让人羡慕的。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_C.en: Three whole days with no fresh news coming in… Sounds kind of enviable, honestly.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_P.source: 船长宁可在码头多等两天也不盲开进雾区，平平安安比赶那点班期强多了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_P.zh_CN: 船长宁可在码头多等两天也不盲开进雾区，平平安安比赶那点班期强多了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_P.en: Waiting out zero-visibility fog in harbor beats steering a full ferry blind into a freight lane

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_N.source: 人困在候船厅吃第三桶泡面就算了，连岛上便利店的鲜奶架子都快搬空了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_N.zh_CN: 人困在候船厅吃第三桶泡面就算了，连岛上便利店的鲜奶架子都快搬空了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_COASTAL_FOG_FERRY_HALT_N.en: Three bowls of terminal instant noodles later, the island convenience stores are down to their last cartons of milk

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_T.source: 科考队在千米深废盐矿卤水中发现噬碳菌群
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_T.zh_CN: 科考队在千米深废盐矿卤水中发现噬碳菌群
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_T.en: Geologists find carbon-eating microbes in flooded salt mine

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_N.source: %s地质研究所抽检一座停产盐矿的深层热卤水时，意外分离出一种靠吞食溶解二氧化碳繁殖的耐高温古菌。枯燥的显微镜染色延时录像被学生配上鼓点传上网，三天播放破了百万。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_N.zh_CN: %s地质研究所抽检一座停产盐矿的深层热卤水时，意外分离出一种靠吞食溶解二氧化碳繁殖的耐高温古菌。枯燥的显微镜染色延时录像被学生配上鼓点传上网，三天播放破了百万。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_N.en: Sampling hot brine a kilometer down an abandoned salt mine, geologists in %s isolate a heat-loving archaeon that feeds on dissolved carbon dioxide. A grad student sets the microscope time-lapse to a drumbeat, racking up a million views in three days.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_C.source: 菌群还在培养皿里慢慢吐泡泡呢，外头卖概念股的倒先把庆功宴开上了，哦~科学进展哪有他们编故事跑得快。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_C.zh_CN: 论文还没发出来，显微镜录像靠着鼓点先红了。搞科研有时候也得讲究一点节奏感。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_C.en: The paper isn't even out yet and the microscope clip already blew up thanks to a drumbeat. Science comes down to rhythm sometimes.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_P.source: 谁能想到荒了二十年的老盐井底下，藏着这么一群闷头吃碳的小东西
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_P.zh_CN: 谁能想到荒了二十年的老盐井底下，藏着这么一群闷头吃碳的小东西
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_P.en: Who would've guessed an old salt shaft abandoned for twenty years had a colony of little carbon-eaters busy down in the dark

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_N.source: 实验室里刚养活几管子菌，股票群里居然已经有人开始炒盐矿周边的地皮了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_N.zh_CN: 实验室里刚养活几管子菌，股票群里居然已经有人开始炒盐矿周边的地皮了
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_DEEP_WELL_MICROBE_FIND_N.en: The lab has three test tubes alive and speculators are already flipping land around the old minehead

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.zh_CN: 交通部在货运干线划出夜间无人重卡专用车道
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.en: Transport ministry reserves night highway lane for driverless heavy trucks

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.source: %s交通部将两条跨区高速的最右侧车道设为晚十点至早五点的无人驾驶重卡专道，社会车辆误入即抓拍扣分。长途卡车司机吐槽服务区车位本就不够，如今连夜路慢车道都让给了铁疙瘩。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.zh_CN: %s交通部将两条跨区高速的最右侧车道设为晚十点至早五点的无人驾驶重卡专道，社会车辆误入即抓拍扣分。长途卡车司机吐槽服务区车位本就不够，如今连夜路慢车道都让给了铁疙瘩。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.en: %s reserves the right-hand lane on two freight highways from ten p.m. to five a.m. exclusively for autonomous heavy trucks, fining human drivers caught on camera inside it. Long-haul truckers complain rest-stop parking was already scarce before machines got their own lane.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.source: 给机器专门划条道倒是不怕它打瞌睡，就是苦了隔壁车道握方向盘的老师傅，半夜跟一排没司机的重卡并排跑，心里总归有点发毛。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.zh_CN: 半夜在高速上跟一排驾驶座空着的重卡并排开，换我也想离远一点。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.en: Cruising down the highway at midnight next to a row of heavy rigs with empty driver's seats… I'd give them a wide berth too.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.source: 半夜跑长途最怕疲劳走神，让雷达车队走固定专道反而少了追尾风险
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.zh_CN: 半夜跑长途最怕疲劳走神，让雷达车队走固定专道反而少了追尾风险
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.en: Keeping radar-guided freight convoys in one predictable night lane cuts down on drowsy rear-end crashes

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.source: 活人司机在服务区抢不到一张睡觉的铺位，路上倒先给无人车腾出整条好道
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.zh_CN: 活人司机在服务区抢不到一张睡觉的铺位，路上倒先给无人车腾出整条好道
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_AUTONOMOUS_FREIGHT_CORRI.en: Human drivers can't find a legal rest-area berth at midnight, yet driverless rigs get a freshly paved lane to themselves
